Vi hälsar dig varmt välkommen att prova, jämföra och upptäcka viner från några av Frankrikes främsta vinregioner! Svenska vinimportörer finns på plats för att guida dig genom provningarna och hjälpa dig att hitta nya favoriter. Utöver vinerna kan du även njuta av franska ostar, charkuterier och många andra delikatesser. Alla matprodukter finns även till försäljning på plats. I biljettpriset för franska Vindagen 2026 ingår öppna vinprovningar utan kuponger Dagen är indelad i tre provningspass samt två Masterclass: 12.00–14.00 (Pass 1) 15.00–17.00 (Pass 2) / Slutsålt 18.00–20.00 (Pass 3) Plats Münchenbryggeriet – Mälarsalen EXTRA AKTIVITETER I SAMARBETE MED VINKÄLLAN: För dig som vill fördjupa dina kunskaper om franska viner erbjuder vi, i samarbete med Vinkällan, två exklusiva masterclass-provningar under dagen, ledda av Anders Melldén, en av Sveriges mest uppskattade vinprofiler. Tema: Upptäck Frankrike genom dess vinregioner Masterclass 1: kl. 14.00–15.00 (före pass 2) / Slutsålt Masterclass 2: kl. 17.00–18.00 (före pass 3) / Få platser kvar Endast 40 platser per masterclass. title.en: Svartklubben - Mat & Musik i Mörker - Lunch

ai.en: A lunch session at Svartklubben in Stockholm, a dark dining experience with food, specially composed music and sensory experiences, guided by visually impaired hosts.

events.description: På den legala Svartklubben får du njuta av läcker mat, specialkomponerad musik och fantastiska sinnesupplevelser. Här får du rika möjligheter att utforska mat, dryck och underhållning på ett nytt sätt! Hur fungerar det att kommunicera utan syn för dig och din grupp? Fascineras av synskadade sjungande servitörer. Utmana dig själv och ät en unik måltid! Det här är garanterat en stark upplevelse med många nya dimensioner. Skrämmande? Ingen fara. Det här mörkret är varmt och välkomnande! Menyn hålls hemlig för att förhöja upplevelsen! - Trerätters. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning och en trerättersmeny. - Trerätters Deluxe. I priset ingår mörkerupplevelsen, underhållning, en trerättersmeny med välkomstdrink samt två glas vin/öl, kaffe & dessertvin. - Dryck beställs på plats. OBS! - Om du eller någon i ditt sällskap behöver specialkost kan ni boka det via vår hemsida www.svartklubben.com/specialkost. Detta måste göras senast 24 timmar innan eventet. Tider: Insläppstid: 12:00 Baren öppnar kl. 12.00. Eventet startar kl. 12.30. Spellängd: 3 tim 30 min Mer info: www.svartklubben.com

title.en: Family Show - Mamma Mia! The Party

ai.en: A family show of Mamma Mia! The Party at Tyrol, an interactive show inspired by the songs of the musical.

events.description: An entertaining family show inspired by the popular music of Mamma Mia. The experience takes place at Tyrol and offers an interactive and festive environment for all ages. The show combines singing, dancing, and acting.

ai.en: Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar, a newly written musical at Göta Lejon based on Jonas Gardell's novel and TV series.

events.description: TORKA ALDRIG TÅRAR UTAN HANDSKAR -- EN HELT NYSKRIVEN MUSIKAL Jonas Gardells roman och tv-serie Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar fullkomligt välte Sverige hösten 2012. Ett helt svenskt folk förälskade sig i Rasmus och Benjamin och deras vänner med den legendariska fjollan Paul i spetsen. För första gången i Sverige presenteras nu en scenversion, i form av en helt nyskriven musikal av Fredrik Kempe och Jonas Gardell! Premiär på Göta Lejon i Stockholm den 24 september 2026. Regisserar gör Carl Johan Karlson, som gjorde kultföreställningen Arv på Dramaten. I huvudrollerna ser vi Ola Salo som Paul och som Rasmus och Benjamin ser vi Valdemar Wahlbeck och Martin Stokke Mathiesen. Med orkester under ledning av Karl-Johan Ankarblom och stor ensemble, för att inte tala om en fullkomligt slösande påkostad scenografi av Magdalena Åberg, blir detta 2026 års Stora Scen-händelse i Stockholm! Jonas Gardell och Fredrik Kempe har tidigare skrivit musikalen Livet är en schlager, en jättesuccé med 200 000 besökare, och Fredrik Kempe har sedan dess haft stora framgångar med musikalerna Såsom i Himmelen och Änglagård. Nu återförenas de alltså i en musikal som de arbetat med tillsammans sedan 2019 Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar blev av DN:s läsare vald till en av de tre viktigaste kulturhändelserna i Sverige på 150 år! Den gjorde Jonas Gardell till Årets Svensk, tv-serien har utsetts till "Bästa svenska TV-serie genom tiderna" och böckerna har sålt i 100 000-tals exemplar. Rekommenderas från 13…

title.en: Below Zero - In Praise of Shadows

ai.en: Below Zero's In Praise of Shadows at Nya Cirkus in Stockholm, a circus show with seven acrobats moving to newly written folk music.

events.description: Poetisk värme och hisnande energi när Cirkuskompaniet Below Zero står på scen In Praise of Shadows är en hyllning till skuggorna inom oss såväl som runt oss. Med en scenografi som för tankarna till bergen, haven, vågorna och glaciären rör sig sju akrobater till tonerna av nyskriven folkmusik som framförs live på scen. Viskande fioler övergår till trummor och club beats. Catwalk i haute couture varvas med riskfyllda balansakter och halsbrytande volter. Kroppar slungas flera meter upp i luften för att gestalta naturens kraft och skörhet när cirkuskonst tar formen av stormande hav och svepande trädkronor. En storslagen helhet, en hyllning till naturen och en hommage till det ofullkomliga. En familjeföreställning med svindlande akrobatik och nyskriven livemusik. Cirkuskompaniet Below Zeros In Praise of Shadows är en visuell och fysisk storm som beskrivs som vild, vacker och oförutsägbar. Föreställningslängd: 60 min. Rekommenderas från 7 år Om kompaniet Below Zero är ett svenskt cirkuskompani baserat i Stockholm. Deras konstnärliga uttryck tar avstamp i det nordiska klimatet, där kyla och utsatthet kontrasteras mot värme, närhet och mänskliga möten. Namnet Below Zero syftar till artisternas förmåga att trotsa tyngdlagen, att flyga nästan som fallande snöflingor. Kompaniet turnerar både nationellt och internationellt.

Här får du rika möjligheter att utforska mat, dryck och underhållning på ett nytt sätt! Hur fungerar det att kommunicera utan syn för dig och din grupp? Fascineras av synskadade sjungande servitörer. ai.en: Bruckner's Mass in F minor performed at Katarina Kyrka in Stockholm, with soloists, Cappella Catharinae and Katarina Kammarkör under Hans Vainikainen.

events.description: Bruckner låter tidern sakta ner. Långa bågar växer fram ur tystnaden. Väldig musik för stor orkester och kör! Agnes Auer, sopran Katija Dragojevic, alt Carl Unander Scarin, tenor Carl Ackerfeldt, bas Cappella Catharinae Katarina Kammarkör Orkestern Filialen Dirigent: Hans Vainikainen Numrerade platser, portarna öppnas kl 17.15.

UPPLEV IDOL LIVE! Välkommen till en oförglömlig kväll där drömmar kan bli verklighet och stjärnor föds! På Idol Live får du uppleva den magiska stämningen på nära håll när Sveriges nästa stjärna kliver upp på scen. En kväll fylld av musik och storslagna ögonblick! Var med och heja fram din idol hela vägen fram till vinsten. Träffa Pär Lärnström, Idoljuryn och kanske en och annan gästartist. Missa inte chansen att uppleva Idol Live! Sjung med och känn pulsen Åldersgräns 13 år (7 år i Målsmans sällskap) Dörrar öppnar kl 18:00 Dörrar stänger kl 19:15 Eventet slutar kl 22:45

title.en: BENJAMIN INGROSSO | WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? | Platinumbiljetter

events.description: Till det här evenemanget kan du köpa Ticketmaster Platinumbiljetter. • Begränsat antal och endast tillgängligt på Ticketmaster.se. • Max6 st biljetter per person. Åldersgräns: 13 år

ai.en: GERD releases her album More Water Than Anything and starts her first Swedish tour in two and a half years at Pustervik in Göteborg on 16 October. The show is at Vasateatern in Stockholm.

events.description: GERD följer upp nya albumet med sin första Sverige-turné på två och ett halvt år Den 25 september släpper GERD albumet "More Water Than Anything" och nu är det klart att hon även ger sig ut på en turné som inleds den 16 oktober på Pustervik i Göteborg. På nya skivan med P3 Guld-vinnaren får det elektroniska, organiska och orkestrala samspela utan att pressas in i en given mall. Slutresultatet låter större och mer kompromisslöst än något hon gjort tidigare. Med albumet "More Water Than Anything" får musikens driv och framåtrörelse förkroppsliga hur skapandekraft kan övervinna tvivel. "Det är det mest personliga jag gjort", säger GERD om skivan. "Jag har inte riktigt vågat öppna den dörren tidigare och det är så klart läskigt men också kul. Det har dessutom gett texterna ett annat djup. " Omgiven av skog, vatten och långa nätter på en avskild ö i Värmland började hon laborera fram låtar parallellt med att en dragning till folktro och väsen växte fram. Undan för undan satte omgivningen -- skogen, tystnaden, känslan av något som rörde sig i utkanten -- spår i det inre och färgade såväl uttryck som innehåll. Trots stora framgångar de senaste åren, med internationell uppmärksamhet, hyllningar för debutsingeln "Lies for a Liar", en P3 Guld-vinst i kategorin Framtidens artist och uppmärksammade liveframträdanden, kom en period för GERD då kreativiteten inte längre kändes självklar. I arbetet med nya skivan blev det viktigt att hitta tillbaka till ett mer intuitivt sätt att skapa…

title.en: Open sauna and cold plunge in Riddersvik

ai.en: Open sauna and cold plunge at Saunify Bastu Hässelby, by Lake Mälaren, in an old orchard park.

events.description: Experience open sauna sessions by Mälaren in Hässelby, where the old orchard park slopes down to the water. Each session is open to anyone and a spot is booked in advance. Between rounds the jetty is a few steps across the grass. Sessions run year round, with the sharpest contrast in the winter months. Bring swimwear and a towel.

ai.en: Kurt and Kio at Teater Tre, a playful show for ages 3 to 6 about imagination and friendship.

events.description: A playful tribute to imagination, friendship and the magic of everyday life. Kurt and Kio are bored – really bored. The kind of bored where you stare at the ceiling and sigh. But Kio has an idea: a fort! The perfect solution to everything. The only problem is, they don’t have one. Their search for the perfect fort becomes an unexpected adventure – right in the living room. A story about friendship, play, and finding magic in the little things.

title.en: The joyful world of Stig Lindberg

events.description: In the summer of 2026, the Porcelain Museum in Gustavsberg will open an exhibition about Stig Lindberg – one of Sweden's most beloved and versatile designers. Marking the 110th anniversary of his birth, you are invited into a colorful and playful world of design.

title.en: Gamla Stan Walking Tour: Hidden Stories of Stockholm’s Old Town

ai.en: A walking tour of Gamla Stan, the medieval heart of Stockholm, through its alleys and squares, from the Royal Palace.

events.description: Discover Gamla Stan, Stockholm's medieval heart, on a guided walk through alleys and squares where trade, crafts and everyday life once shaped the city. From Slottsbacken to Slussen, hear stories of power, people and hidden corners that bring history to life.

ai.en: A Stockholm food tour at Östermalms Saluhall, visiting restaurants that have shaped Sweden's food scene.

events.description: Join the adventures inside the restaurants that have impacted Sweden's culinary scene. You'll explore the history, roots, and reasons Sweden is becoming a major food destination for locals and world travellers alike!

ai.en: Embraced, an exhibition at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern where visitors become part of the art through sculpture, textile and painting.

events.description: “Embraced” is an exhibition where the viewer not only looks at art, but becomes part of it. Through sculpture, textile, painting, sound, and spatial installations, the body, senses, and presence are activated. Welcome to an immersive art experience featuring contemporary works by Frida Fjellman, Yasmina Karli Malmsten, Sanne Lovén Rolén, and Anna Nyberg.

ai.en: City Faces at the Stockholm City Museum, which brings 19th-century Stockholmers to life using historical photographs and facial recognition.

events.description: By combining historical photographs, biographical data, and digital facial recognition, Stockholm’s 19th-century faces are brought to life. The exhibition is the result of the project “City Faces”, funded by the Swedish Research Council.

ai.en: Chamber/Cacti at the Royal Swedish Opera, two 30-minute modern dance pieces with kinetic energy and humour, by Medhi Walerski.

events.description: Kinetic energy, humour, precision and collective power, in two 30-minute sessions of modern dance expression. Medhi Walerski’s almost ritualistic work Chamber makes its first appearance on stage in Sweden, here in tandem with Cacti – one of many expressive works by Alexander Ekman.

Experience Stockholm in a different way, on a comfortable bike with spectacular views. We pass the most iconic areas at a relaxed pace and take a nice break in the middle of the tour. This experience is for people from all over the world and also for 'Stockholmers'. A special Swedish-Dutch history tour is also offered. Tours are given at 9.30 and 13.30 every day.

title.en: Colour! An exhibition for children and curious grown-ups

ai.en: Colour!, an exhibition at Nationalmuseum for children and curious adults. It is open at weekends and in school holidays.

events.description: Note: The exhibition is open on weekends and school holidays.Become a colour explorer! Put on a lab coat, slip on a pair of color goggles, and step through the colour portal. Experience and explore colour in different ways in the exhibition’s vibrant and immersive rooms. Colour! is a sensory and playful exhibition aimed at children aged 6–12 and their curious adults.

title.en: Antiques and vintage market at Karlaplan

events.description: Great market for both antiques bargaining and second hand jeans! This flea market is extremely popular on TikTok :) New vendors every Saturday (about 100 every day) so great potential for finding real treasures. You'll find the market in the park around the fountain of Karlaplan. Stroll through the market, have a fika and enjoy a day in the park.

ai.en: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum, an evolving display of photography collections, opening with Metamorphoses.

events.description: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum highlights photographic collections in an evolving presentation. The opening exhibition Metamorphoses displays negatives rescued from the project 100,000 Photo Memories, where time and chemistry created new visual expressions. On view from October 17, 2025.

ai.en: An art exhibition at Åmells gallery on Birger Jarlsgatan, with around ten carefully chosen shows a year.

events.description: Welcome to an art exhibition in Stockholm, held at Åmells Gallery on Birger Jarlsgatan 14. Every year, they display around ten carefully curated presentations of Scandinavian art for sale. Admission is always free, and information about current and upcoming exhibitions is available on Åmells website.

ai.en: Bybit Stockholm Open 2026 at The Royal Tennis Hall, a tennis tournament founded in 1969 at the initiative of Sven Davidson.

events.description: Stockholm Open was founded in 1969 at the initiative of former world player Sven Davidson. Over a week in October, around 30,000 visitors flock to the Royal Tennis Hall, and the event is made possible by more than 350 volunteers. The tournament is the world’s oldest indoor ATP event and the only one played in an indoor arena specifically built for tennis. Global stars such as Björn Borg, John McEnroe, Roger Federer, Boris Becker, Mats Wilander, and Stefan Edberg have all won the tournament.

title.en: The Viking World – the world’s largest Viking exhibition

events.description: The myth of the violent, plundering Vikings (with horned helmets) has been circulating for a long time. But what do we really know about life in Nordic countries one thousand years ago?

title.en: War of the Corsets – Fighting to Shape Femininity at the Turn of the Last Century

events.description: The corset is one of the most controversial garments in the history of fashion. It has been worn for centuries, shaping women's bodies according to the ideals of different times. It came into particular focus at the end of the 19th century. A lively debate flared up in Sweden, which came to be known as the corset war.

Ghost Hunt in Gamla Stan is an exciting, educational, and interactive city adventure where your smartphone guides you through Stockholm’s oldest quarters. As you discover fascinating history, real historical events, and dark legends, your team navigates narrow cobblestone alleys to solve clever riddles and uncover the city’s hidden secrets.

ai.en: A two-hour glassfusing workshop at The Creativity House, where participants make jewellery such as a necklace, ring or earrings.

events.description: Make amazing glass jewelry with beautiful opaque, transparent, and dichroic glass in various colors and patterns to choose from. During this 2 hour long session you will be able to create: necklace, ring, keychain, brooch, bracelet, or earrings. You will get a full introduction where you’ll learn how to use tools like running pliers and glass cutters to create your jewelry.

Iconic Collaborations at Sven-Harry’s Art Museum presents a groundbreaking exhibition, bringing together—for the first time—the designer collections created for H&M. The show highlights some of the most distinguished names in fashion, such as Karl Lagerfeld, Stella McCartney, Maison Martin Margiela, Kenzo, and Sonia Rykiel.

ai.en: An advanced beer tasting with a guided tour of Omnipollos Kyrka, from the brewery through the church.

events.description: Advanced beer tasting with guided tour. This experience includes a guided tour through the entire church, from the brewery to the atelier where all our labels are created. After the tour, you’ll enjoy a tasting of six carefully selected beers: both Omnipollo classics and more exclusive varieties such as sour beers and powerful stouts. An experience for anyone who wants a deeper insight into Omnipollo’s craft, environment, and the creative process behind every bottle. Duration: approx. 2 hours.

title.en: Guided Tour in the Historical Food Hall Östermalms Saluhall

ai.en: A guided tour of the historic Östermalms Saluhall food hall, renovated and reopened in 2020.

events.description: Newly renovated and more beautiful than ever. Östermalm's Saluhall re-opened its doors in 2020 after an extensive renovation. Book a guided tour in one of Stockholm's most beloved buildings. Your host is Lina Bielsten, founder of Östermalm's Saluhall Magasin (2010-2023). Lina presents the 135-year history of the market hall and architectural details, mixed with funny anecdotes from famous guests. A behind-the-scenes tour in which food samples can be added. Tours can be booked on request.

ai.en: A design exhibition at Artipelag, created by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, exploring the inner child as a source of creativity.

events.description: What happens when we dare to see the world through the curious eyes of a child? Artipelag presents a unique design exhibition exploring the inner child as a source of creativity, hope, and the joy of making. Created exclusively for Artipelag by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, the exhibition brings together the work of one hundred designers and artists in an inspiring narrative about playfulness, imagination, and the human need to create with our hands.

ai.en: A jazz brunch at Nalen, one of Stockholm's historic jazz venues, with live music from young musicians.

events.description: Enjoy live jazz performed by young musicians and a delicious, generous brunch in one of Stockholm’s most historic jazz venues. The table-served menu is served in four courses: brunch shot, brunch brioche, brunch platter and dessert platter.

The exhibition "Fabriken" (The Factory) tells the story of nearly 200 years of silk weaving. Built around three themes spanning from the 1800s to today, it is brought to life through the history of K. A. Almgren Silk Weaving Mill. Meet some of the women who worked here, and discover the silk shawls, order ribbons, and gowns they wove and sewed.
events.venueId: v-stockholm-k. a. almgren silk weaving mill & museum
events.venue: K. A. Almgren Silk Weaving Mill & Museum

events.description: Flatenbastun offers a relaxed lakeside sauna experience by Lake Flaten in southern Stockholm. Here, warmth, nature and refreshing swims come together in a social and welcoming setting for both regulars and first-time guests. Open sauna sessions are available year-round and booked in advance via the website. Bring swimwear and towels for a genuine Swedish sauna experience close to nature.

In the 62nd edition of the world-renowned Wildlife Photographer of the Year exhibition, you will discover wildlife photography at its very best. Explore the extraordinary diversity of our planet through spectacular moments and stories that both fascinate and move us. The photographs capture rarely seen moments, revealing the beauty, power, and vulnerability of nature. From an impressive 65,403 entries submitted by photographers from 121 countries, just 100 photographs have been selected.

ai.en: Reality, an interactive Swedish-language film experience at Konträr, where the audience watches a feature being filmed and can become extras.

events.description: In Reality, the audience follows the filming of a feature film, and may even become part of the movie as extras. Using technology and AI, the room transforms into various environments, from a cottage in Hälsingland to a spaceship. The performance explores what makes life real and our longing to truly feel alive.

Express your creativity by painting pre-made pottery pieces from a wide range of designs. Whether it’s a fun kids’ activity, a special celebration, or some well-deserved me time, our 2-hour pottery painting sessions are perfect for all ages and skill levels.

In The Swedish National Maritime Museum's new exhibition, Paddle!, you can follow the story of paddling – from historical long-distance journeys to today’s outdoor life – and discover why people are continually drawn to the water. The exhibition engages the whole body. Explore different paddling environments, from forest lakes to the open sea, and experience how paddling can offer both adventure and tranquillity.

title.en: “Patrizia Cavalli. Che cosa è mio?” by Lorenzo Castore

ai.en: A photo exhibition at the Italian Cultural Institute in Stockholm, by Lorenzo Castore, shot in the apartment of the poet Patrizia Cavalli shortly after her death.

events.description: The Italian Cultural Institute in Stockholm presents the photo exhibition "Patrizia Cavalli. Che cosa è mio?" by Lorenzo Castore. The exhibition consists of photos taken in the poet Patrizia Cavalli's apartment shortly after her passing. An apartment where she had created her personal universe for over 50 years. From pictures of entire rooms to detailed shots of messy drawers, in every photograph you can feel Cavalli's presence. An intimate portrait of an extraordinary cultural personality.
Learn about diplomat Per Anger's efforts to rescue Jews during the Second World War, and meet brave human rights defenders who follow in his footsteps. Closed on sundays.

Sixty years after the original Visioner av Nuet festival, Tekniska revisits the meeting point between art and technology. Archive films, electronic music and talks bring the experimental ideas of 1966 back to life. In the evening, Wisdome shifts to the present with live coding, algorithmic music and Fredrik Gran’s Feedback Robot. A journey through how computers, sound, code and robotics have become artistic tools – from 1966 to today.

title.en: The Wonder of Colours – Gothenburg Colourism in a New Light

ai.en: An exhibition at Prins Eugens Waldemarsudde on the Gothenburg Colourists, including Ivan Ivarson, Ragnar Sandberg, Inge Schiöler and Märta Taube-Ivarson, alongside their forerunners.

events.description: Step into a world of vivid colour, where brushstrokes pulse with rhythm, emotion, and life. This extensive presentation introduces us to the beloved Gothenburg Colourists – from Ivan Ivarson, Ragnar Sandberg and Inge Schiöler to Åke Göransson and Märta Taube-Ivarson – alongside both their forerunners and followers. Visitors will encounter both iconic masterpieces and rarely shown works. The exhibition has been produced in collaboration with the Gothenburg Museum of Art.

ai.en: Young Opera: Lost, a whimsical dream play with music by Andrea Tarrodi at the Royal Swedish Opera, reminiscent of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.

events.description: "The opera is simply a little gem – lucky are those who manage to secure a ticket!” wrote Dagens Nyheter after the 2024 premiere. Now, Lost (Vilse) is finally back! Lost is a whimsical dream play that is reminiscent of Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, with music by Andrea Tarrodi – one of our most acclaimed contemporary Swedish composers. Its 2024 première proved popular with critics and audiences of all ages. This is a truly great musical experience in a small format.

ai.en: Pottery painting at Måla Keramiks studios in central Stockholm, a new concept where you paint your own ceramics.

events.description: Pottery painting as it should be - MålaKeramik.se is a brand new concept with several studios in central Stockholm. Our ambition is to offer as many people as possible the chance to paint pottery in Stockholm in some of the capital's most beautiful environments. With a wide range items from cups and plates to vases and decorations, you can paint your own unique pottery and ceramics. Welcome to enjoy some analog quality time with us!

On November 12, the photo exhibition 'Nuances of Södermalm' opens, the first in a new series organized by the non-profit association PLANKET Stockholm. Thirteen photographers, ranging in age from 17 to 85, present works connected to Södermalm and Slussen, spanning different eras and perspectives.

ai.en: The Lady in Black at Ormteatern, a Gothic horror play about revenge, love and grief set in the mid-19th century.

events.description: The play is a Gothic horror production and a story of revenge, love, and grief. The story is set in the mid-19th century. The story follows a young lawyer Arthur Falk who travels north to settle a will from an estate. Once at the house, he notices he is not alone; someone else is there—a lady in black. Are these experiences hallucinations, or are they reality? By Stephen Mallatratt, based on a book by Susan Hill. Directed by Susanna Forsberg. From 13 years.

Dröse & Norberg proudly presents VIKING – A Live Action Musical – Harald’s Blood Revenge, an epic musical experience for adult audiences. Performed in a spectacular purpose-built arena tent, this intense production brings the brutal and passionate Viking Age to life. Featuring 25 performers, including Håkan Hemlin from NORDMAN in his musical theatre debut, alongside Joakim Nätterqvist and Anna Norberg. Written and directed by Robert Dröse, with original music by Theo and Robert Dröse.

title.en: Guided Winter Hike with Campfire Lunch

events.description: Explore Sweden’s winter nature on a guided hike through Nacka Nature Reserve, just 20 minutes from central Stockholm. Walk through quiet forests and over granite cliffs, with views across the winter landscape. Take a break along the way and warm up with a freshly cooked lunch prepared over an open fire.

title.en: Jesus Christ Superstar at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern

ai.en: Jesus Christ Superstar at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's rock musical about Jesus's last days.

events.description: In Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's beloved rock musical, we follow Jesus' last days of life. How his grassroots movement shakes the grip of power over the people. Where the road to crucifixion is shaped by the struggle between light and darkness. A drama marked by faith, doubt, and power. The cast includes Alexander Lycke, Fredrik Lycke, and Marsha Songcome. Directed by Maria Sid. Premiere October 9.

title.en: Mamma Moo and Crow’s Christmas – Children’s Theatre in Swedish

ai.en: Mamma Moo and Crow's Christmas at Teater Bristol, a Swedish children's theatre show about a surprise Christmas present for a farmer.

events.description: It is Christmas Eve tomorrow, and Mamma Moo wants to surprise the farmer with an unusual Christmas present. Meanwhile, Crow rushes home to arrange presents for himself. Based on the book by Jujja Wieslander, the story explores friendship, expectations, and what matters most at Christmas. The performance is in Swedish, lasts about 35 minutes and is recommended for children aged 3 and above.

title.en: Family weekends at the Nobel Prize Museum

ai.en: Family weekends at the Nobel Prize Museum, with weekend activities on chemistry in which children make reactions with liquids.

events.description: Learn about chemistry by creating reactions and transforming different liquids in the museum’s weekend activity for children and families.

title.en: Robert and Barbro Nilsson - Life in color and form

ai.en: Life in color and form, an exhibition at Millesgården on the sculptor Robert Nilsson and the textile artist Barbro Nilsson.

events.description: Robert Nilsson, sculptor, and Barbro Nilsson, textile artist and artistic director of AB Märta Måås-Fjetterström's weaving studio, were a creative couple who left a strong mark on 20th-century Swedish sculpture and textile art. The exhibition features works from the couple's oeuvre—including textiles, sculpture, and painting - alongside sketches, models, and archival material. The exhibition is a collaboration with Blå Hallen, Höganäs, with guest curators Xi Wallén Keller and Martin Enget.

Ten years of the scholarship competition The Thinking Hand has come to an end. A jubilee exhibition will open in October 2026 featuring the artists and scholarship recipients during ten years. This marks the end of the scholarship competition, which was first established to commemorate His Majesty the King’s 70th birthday in 2016. The scholarship competition and exhibition is a collaboration between the Royal Court and the Royal Academy of Fine Arts.

title.en: In Royal Service – guards, maids of honour and lackeys

events.description: In the Royal Armoury’s new colourful exhibition, In Royal Service, you are given a glimpse into life at the royal court. Magnificent costumes, gleaming silver trumpets, and striking portraits introduce some of the men and women who served the monarchy during the 17th and 18th centuries, through the traces they left behind.

title.en: Guided Hike in Stockholm Nature Reserve + Campfire Lunch

events.description: Take a break from the hustle and bustle of Stockholm and immerse yourself in the serene surroundings of the Nacka Nature Reserve. Just a quick 20-minute drive from the city, this beautiful reserve is the perfect place to spend a day in nature. Enjoy a leisurely walk through the dense forests and over the high granite cliffs, taking in the views and fresh air. You will also be treated to a campfire-cooked lunch, adding an authentic touch to your experience.

title.en: Guided tour of the Opera House in English

ai.en: A guided tour of the Royal Swedish Opera in English, with personal tours from guides with their own backgrounds.

events.description: All our guides have different backgrounds and special interests, so the tours are always very personal. Someone has danced at the Opera for 20 years, another has studied art in depth and a third knows ALL about Gustav III, who established the Royal Swedish Opera in 1773 and who built the country's first opera house, in which he was later murdered in 1792.

title.en: Peter Hägerås – “Album Covers, Watercolors & Flying Saucers”

ai.en: Album Covers, Watercolors & Flying Saucers, an exhibition by Peter Hägerås at Presentmakeriet, diverse and playful work.

events.description: The exhibition is diverse and playful. Some works have a specific purpose, while others have no purpose other than the fact that Peter wanted to paint them. Music and visual art have constantly been allowed to blend together. In conjunction with the exhibition, Peter is releasing new music, with some of the paintings once again serving as album covers.Vernissage: Thursday, Oct 29.

With almost 400 objects in the postal history exhibition, POST welcomes visitors to an experiential and interactive exhibition that activates all the senses. Here you can follow the history of the post office from the 17th century until today. The exhibition highlights the hard work and both the people who made communication between people possible over five centuries and those who received mail. An exhibition for both adults and children.

title.en: Like share hate – An Exhibition on Antisemitism

ai.en: Like Share Hate, an exhibition at Forum för levande historia on antisemitism and other forms of racism, and how to stop them.

events.description: How is our society affected by antisemitism and other forms of racism? And what can we do to stop it? In this exhibition, you will learn more about how to decode antisemitic messages and how your social media-feed is influenced by your behavior. You will also meet people who have been subjected to hate, both online and in real life. And you’ll get advice on how we can work against hatred.

ai.en: A Calvados tasting in Stockholm, learning about this French apple brandy from Normandy.

events.description: Join a Calvados tasting in Stockholm, where you’ll learn about the history of this French apple brandy from Normandie, how it’s made, and what it pairs best with. The event begins with an introduction from an expert, followed by a guided tasting where you sample different expressions and explore their flavors at a relaxed pace. Bring your friends and discover this unique spirit in a fun and educational way.
A curated evening at Stockholms Bränneri where classical music meets club beats and cocktails. Feel at home, sit back and experience a new kind of night out.

ai.en: Blowing Figures into Space by Davide Rivalta, a large outdoor sculpture show of twelve animal figures in Kungliga Nationalstadsparken.

events.description: Blowing Figures into Space by the sculptor Davide Rivalta is a large-scale outdoor exhibition. It comprises twelve animal sculptures in bronze and aluminum, installed in symbolic locations, creating new perspectives on nature, power and coexistence. The sculptures are placed directly on the ground making them appear as if they have reclaimed the urban environment. Through this approach, Rivalta makes art accessible in public spaces and promotes dialogue across cultures. Guided tours each month.

title.en: K:18 VIN - A wine pop-up in Stockholm with a focus on Systembolagets order assortment

events.description: From November 6–14, K:18 VIN invites wine lovers to explore a curated selection of wines from Systembolaget’s special order assortment at Kungsgatan 18 in central Stockholm. Enjoy a guided tasting of three wines with a sommelier, then relax at the on-site wine bar. Tickets are available via co:labs website, and extra tickets can be bought at the venue. Open to guests aged 20 and over.

What is justice after the Holocaust? The trials after the Holocaust have served multiple purposes. Beyond establishing individual responsibility, they have helped shape legal precedent and historical narratives. As a result, new laws and legal practices emerged. In this exhibition, you will explore the many hundreds of cases brought after the Holocaust and gain an understanding of how both the Holocaust itself and the efforts to address Nazi crimes have shaped our present.

title.en: Ylva Snöfrid, The House of the Muses

events.description: The House of the Muses is Snöfrid’s largest exhibition to date and spans four hundred paintings, thousands of drawings, and specially crafted objects. In 13 halls, you can encounter the nine muses and the four elements, and engage in 34 rituals where installations and paintings are brought into use.

ai.en: A self-paced food tour in Stockholm, visiting four selected restaurants using a digital map.

events.description: Join a food tour in Stockholm where you visit four selected restaurants at your own pace. Using a digital map, you walk between stops, show your ticket, and enjoy tasting samples from each menu. Experience great food, drinks, and a lively atmosphere with friends or on a date.

Join us on a journey to the land of imagination in the exhibition A World of Tales. Here, children and their grown-ups can listen to stories from around the globe – myths, legends, creation tales, and fairy tales. Admission is free for everyone under 19.

ai.en: Shul!, the synagogue of the Old Town, at the Jewish Museum on Själagårdsgatan, where a synagogue once stood.

events.description: At Själagårdsgatan 19, where the Jewish Museum is housed, a synagogue once stood. The synagogue served as a centre of Jewish life in the city and across the country. For nearly a century, from 1795 to 1870, the Jews of Stockholm gathered here to take part in community life and to seek guidance and support from the rabbi. The people who prayed, lived, and worked here were pioneers of Jewish life in Sweden. This exhibition tells their story and the story of their Old Town shul.

ai.en: The Stockholm International Film Festival 2026, a film festival with screenings across the city.

events.description: Whether you want to be moved, surprised, inspired, or simply escape into another world for a while, the Stockholm International Film Festival is the place to be. The program features everything from glamorous Red-Carpet screenings, gala premieres, and award-winning festival favorites to Face2Face conversations with directors and actors. It’s not just about watching films. It’s about truly experiencing them together.

title.en: Lake Sauna by Mälaren at Kaggeholm Castle

events.description: Experience open sauna sessions in a lakeside sauna at Kaggeholm Castle on Ekerö. A booking covers one spot in the shared sauna. Mälaren sits directly outside for anyone wanting to plunge between rounds. Suits regulars and first timers alike. Bring swimwear and a towel.

ai.en: A weekly Thursday English stand-up night in Södermalm, run by ComedyNation at Pitchers Mariatorget Casino, with local and English-speaking comedians across two hours.

events.description: Every Thursday, ComedyNation the best boutique comedy club proudly present Full English Standup Comedy, a tradition in Södermalm, Stockholm. This two-hour show offers a distinctive blend of comedy styles, showcasing local and English-speaking comedians who bring a variety of tastes and humor to the stage. To fully enjoy the evening, we recommend arriving by 18:00 to savor a meal and drinks at the Mariatorget Pitchers’ casino bar. 18+, door 18:00, show 19:00, limited number of seats.

The National Museum of Science and Technology has created an experience where you can not only try your favorite games and explore the game history, but also step into, and let yourself be immersed by, games. The Play Beyond Play exhibition occupies over 1,000 square meters of gaming fun! Join in on a journey through game history!
events.venueId: v-stockholm-the national museum of science and technology
events.venue: The National Museum of Science and Technology

ai.en: Raymonds Music Café at Bromma Musikscen, a Saturday afternoon with Raymond Björling and Jonas Janson.

events.description: Come together for a Saturday afternoon with Raymond Björling and Jonas Janson. Let yourself be enveloped and warmed by love in various musical forms. A little Jussi, a little Jazz, a little Pop, a little Gospel and gourmet hamburgers with classic accessories.

title.en: Ndidi Dike – Rare Earth Rare Justice

events.description: Färgfabriken is proud to present an exhibition by British-Nigerian artist Ndidi Dike. Rare Earth Rare Justice addresses questions of extraction and postcolonial structures while offering a powerful visual experience in Färgfabriken’s Main Hall.

title.en: Big Ben Stand Up Every Day 8 PM

ai.en: Big Ben Stand Up, a daily stand-up comedy night at 20:00 at the Big Ben Pub.

events.description: Are you ready to laugh until the tears flow? Don't miss the chance to participate in BigBenStandUp & StandUpSverige's daily stand-up performances that promise to brighten your evening! Every day at 20.00, some of Sweden's most talented comedians take the stage to treat you to an evening filled with hysterically funny entertainment and unforgettable moments.

title.en: Ghar Wali Diwali : A Homestyle Indian Festive Dinner

events.description: Ghar Wali Diwali, meaning “Diwali at home” in Hindi, brings the warmth of Indian festive celebrations to Stockholm through an intimate supper club by Indique. Join us for an evening of shared dining, cultural traditions and conversation around a communal table. Whether you're familiar with Diwali or discovering it for the first time, experience the spirit of an Indian home celebration through food, stories, and togetherness.

"Three-dimensionality comes naturally to me as an architect by profession, and 3-dimensional watercolor painting has felt like a natural step forward in my development as a watercolorist. Watercolor paper is firm and stable, but when wet it becomes malleable. For the past 15 years, I have devoted myself to exploring the possibilities of shaping watercolor paper sculpturally – into reliefs and double-sided sculptures in box frames." – Peter Schalin

title.en: Södermalm's heights - city walk with a view

ai.en: A walk along the heights of Södermalm, from Slussen to Medborgarplatsen, with views over the city.

events.description: Join on a walk through Södermalm's historic heights, from Slussen to Medborgarplatsen. Strolling along Glasbruksgatan, Fiskargatan and Mosebacke, enjoy beautiful views and discover stories of people, places and transformation. Learn how Södermalm evolved from a working-class district into one of Stockholm's most creative and vibrant neighbourhoods.

title.en: Jazz Fusion Thursday at The Node

events.description: The Node house band Trio Van Funk plays jazz fusion every Thursday from 4–7 pm at The Node, beneath the Sergel Fountain in central Stockholm.

ai.en: Stories without beginnings by Éva Mag at Marabouparken art gallery, an installation that fills the whole hall.

events.description: In the art gallery’s main hall, Mag creates an installation that takes up the entire space. The surface is transformed into a landscape of welded metal and fired and unfired clay, where uprooted trees, vessels, and thorny branches spread out across the room. The landscape oscillates between decay and survival, exploring the vitality of the materials. They bear traces of the turbulent times we live in and of humanity’s persistent attempts to find balance, stay upright, and carry on.

title.en: Hatt Couture - Royal Hat Fashion at the Royal Armoury.

events.description: Hatt Couture is an exhibition about an imaginative accessory—the hat—worn by Swedish royals from the mid-20th century, the golden age of hats, to the 2000s.

The Old National Archives is hosting its acclaimed Christmas buffet, curated by Niklas Ekstedt, this year open until boxing day. The buffet offers a wide selection of traditional classics, mixed with some newer modern twists. There is also a generous variety of vegetarian options.

With our very popular 'Do it Yourself' sessions, you can throw as much (or as little) as you want, create at a speed that works for you, practice specific techniques or just throw for the sake of throwing - All on your own time and under your terms! Instructions are not included. If you would like instructions for how to create ceramics please book a workshop or a course. We do not teach during the Do It yourself sessions.

This centrally located oasis features a variety of exhibitions on the history of medicines and pharmacies, which you can explore either independently or on a guided tour. The exhibitions include a wealth of informative texts and films that enrich the experience.

ai.en: Mat för livet 2026 at Kistamässan, Sweden's largest gluten- and lactose-free food fair, with tastings, lectures and expert questions.

events.description: Mat för livet Mat för livet är Sveriges största gluten- & laktosfria mässa! Här finner du de senaste nyheterna att provsmaka och köpa till bättre priser. Lyssna på föreläsningar, delta i tävlingar och ställ dina frågor till experter. Är du nyfiken på att veta mer om mässan, se årets utställare och program, finner du allt HÄR Vill du komma in på mässan till rabatterat pris? Som medlem i Celiakiförbundet får du det! Bli medlem: HÄR Medlemskort ska uppvisas vid efterfrågan vid entré om du har en biljett till medlemspris! Barn under 7 år går in gratis utan biljett i målsmans sällskap. Mat för livet-mässans öppettider: Fredag 13 november kl 11-17 Lördag 14 november kl 10-16 Din biljett gäller för det datum du har valt och valfri inpasseringstid. Vid köp av entré på plats kommer priserna att vara 50 kr dyrare än förköp via Ticketmaster. Arrangör: Celiakiföreningen i Stockholms län / Mat för livet

Sean Banan kommer tillbaks som Kung Gibbon på Göta Lejon, gäller bara den 15 samt 22 november. Missa inte det! DJUNGELBOKEN -- THE MUSICAL ETT HELT GALET DJUNGELÄVENTYR -- NU STÖRRE, VILDARE OCH MER SPEKTAKULÄRT! Efter att ha trollbundit över 200.000 besökare är succén tillbaka -- större än någonsin! Följ med på en oförglömlig resa in i den exotiska indiska djungeln och möt de legendariska karaktärerna Baloo, Bagheera, Kaa och den fruktade Shere Kahn. Med humor, fantastisk musik och hisnande akrobatik bjuder Dröse & Norberg på en föreställning som får hela familjen att ryckas med. På scenen står en stor ensemble med några av Sveriges absolut främsta musikalartister. Tillsammans skapar de en show fylld av energi, skratt och magi som måste upplevas live. FAKTA Manus & regi: Robert Dröse Producent: Anna Norberg Musik: Martin Landh, Peter Nygren & Robert Dröse Musik: "Grillad Banan" Theo Dröse & Matilda Winberg Scenografi: Erik Fredriksson Ljusdesign: Palle Palmé Kostymdesign: Wilberth Gonzalez Koreografi: Tuvalisa Esping & Robert Dröse Mask & perukdesign: Johanna Lysdahl & Wilberth Gonzalez Föreställningen är: 2,10 timmar inkl. paus Ålder: 3 - 100 år DJUNGELBOKEN -- THE MUSICAL. En upplevelse för hela människofamiljen.

ai.en: TEDxStockholm: Human After All at Cirkus, a talk on what it means to be human in a world of algorithms and screens.

events.description: What does it truly mean to be human in a world dominated by algorithms, screens, and rapid change? Join TEDx Stockholm to look inward, strip away the noise, and focus on what connects us at our very core. With the theme "Human after all", the event features 10 speakers, 2 artist performances and more. The event is held in English. Expect a powerful day filled with Ideas Worth Spreading.

The Prodigy return to Stockholm after a massive world tour that included era-defining headline shows at Glastonbury and Coachella. Led by Liam Howlett and Maxim, the electronic punk legends promise a brand new live show with dazzling visuals and heavy, pulsating bass. With 35 years of groundbreaking music, seven consecutive UK number-one albums and new material on the way, 2026 looks set to be their biggest year yet.

ai.en: Così fan tutte at the Royal Swedish Opera, a playful opera about relationships, disguises and desire.

events.description: A playful story with darkness at its core — an opera about romantic relationships, disguises, and desire, set to ingeniously crafted music by Mozart.

title.en: Car boot sale at Liljeholmstorget galleria

ai.en: The car boot sale at Liljeholmstorget galleria, a vintage and flea market open for over ten years.

events.description: Welcome to this underground vintage and flea market heaven! For over 10 years this has been Stockholm's most popular winter car boot sale, in the parking garage of Liljeholmstorget galleria. Here you'll find everything from vintage and antiques to children's clothes and sport gadgets - all sorts of things the Stockholmers have cleaned out of their attics and basements. Twice a month (always on a Sunday) you'll find the car boot sale at floor 2 in the parking garage. Very welcome!

ai.en: A monthly Brazilian forró music and dance evening on the Vieille Montagne boat in south Stockholm.

events.description: Join us once a month for a Brazilian evening packed with music and dancing in the south of Stockholm. Forró is a Brazilian dance anyone can try. Simple steps, friendly people, and music that makes it hard to stand still. We start, warm up, and help everyone grow. Beginners learn the basics while returning dancers refine their flow, and before you know it, the venue has turned into a cosy party where you can dance and enjoy the evening with us. Welcome, Välkommen, Bem-vindo

ai.en: I Can!, a physical theatre show for children aged 2 to 5 at Lilla Tre about learning new things.

events.description: I Can! is a poetic physical theatre adventure for the youngest audiences, about the joy of mastering new things. About the challenge of learning, and the pride of suddenly being able to do something you couldn’t before. Through play, humour and movement, the show inspires self-confidence, courage to try again when things go wrong, and creative problem-solving. A journey through challenges and triumphs – for both the 3-year-old and the 63-year-old.

ai.en: American football on the big screen every Sunday evening at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm.

events.description: American Football Sundays at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm Every Sunday evening, join us for American football on the big screens at Hard Rock Cafe Stockholm, in collaboration with NFL Podden. Gather your friends, follow the games and enjoy a great Sunday evening with good food, drinks and live sports.

ai.en: Folk music and dance at Skeppsholmens Folkhögskola, the Folk Music House 'Scheppis' with a programme of folk music.

events.description: Welcome to Stockholm’s folkmusic oasis: The Folk Music House "Scheppis". A very unique cultural space! Folkmusic and dance for everyone! Jamsessions, concerts, workshops, social dancing to live acoustic music, food and drinks (non-alcoholic). Every Sunday (some Fridays) from 6–11 PM.Open house to all newcomers, beginners and experienced visitors. We offer a variety of activities and everything is run non-profit in the spirit of folkmusic!

ai.en: Emil i Lönneberga, a family musical at Intiman based on Astrid Lindgren's stories, running until 30 December.

events.description: EMIL IN LÖNNEBERGA – Family Musical Until December 30! Step into Katthult as Astrid Lindgren's beloved stories come to life at Intiman Theatre in Stockholm! Join Emil, Ida, Alfred and all their friends in a delightful family musical packed with mischief, laughter, singing and dancing. Enjoy Emil's classic adventures and hilarious pranks! A heartwarming experience for the whole family! Performances on Sundays and during the Christmas holidays until December 30. Recommended age: 5+

ai.en: Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen in their first joint concert in Stockholm on 15 November at Berns.

events.description: Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen will perform their first-ever joint concert in Stockholm on Sunday, November 15, 2026. The audience can look forward to an energetic and emotionally charged concert featuring Pete Parkkonen’s biggest hits, Linda Lampenius’ beloved songs from the 1990s, and a spectacular live performance of their Eurovision hit Liekinheitin.

title.en: NK and Disney Unite for a Magical Christmas

events.description: NK in Stockholm is filled with Christmas spirit, Swedish traditions, nostalgia, and playfulness through a new collaboration with Disney. This year’s Christmas window displays and experiences are inspired by Disney’s iconic holiday tradition 'From All of Us to All of You'. Sunday November 15th marks the opening ceremony, with Santa himself arriving by horse carriage.

title.en: Dinner in Darkness in Old town

ai.en: Dinner in Darkness in Gamla Stan, a dining experience in the dark beneath the Old Town's streets.

events.description: Step into the darkness beneath the charming old streets of Gamla Stan, Stockholm, for a truly unique dining experience. In a cozy medieval cellar vault, you will enjoy a two-course dinner served in complete darkness. Without sight, your senses are heightened as you try to guess what you are eating and drinking throughout the evening. A fun, immersive, and unforgettable experience unlike any ordinary dinner.

ai.en: Hammarby IF against Kristianstads DFF at Hammarby IP on the final matchday of the women's Damallsvenskan.

events.description: Hammarby IF hosts Kristianstad at Hammarby IP on the final Matchday of Damallsvenskan, the highest division of women's association football in Sweden.

Walk With Us by Tjamigo – a relaxed walk along Djurgården’s waterfront. Get some fresh air, meet new people and walk at an easy pace with time to chat. Bring a friend, wear comfy shoes and dress for the weather. A thermos of something warm to drink is welcome too! Meet at Blå porten, Djurgården

ai.en: Tinie Tempah at Debaser Strand, the British rapper known for the hit Pass Out.

events.description: When Tinie Tempah broke through with Pass Out in 2010, he didn't just deliver a massive hit—he rewrote the rules of British rap. Now he comes to Stockholm!

title.en: Happy Voices under ledning av Gabriel Forss. Gäst: Uno Sveningsson

ai.en: Happy Voices, a choir conducted by Gabriel Forss, gives a closing concert with gospel, Swedish pop, soul, rock and musical numbers at Filadelfia Convention Center. Uno Sveningsson is the guest.

events.description: Varmt välkommen på konsert med kören Happy Voices, under ledning av körledare Gabriel Forss. Kören har repeterat och finslipat repertoaren under hösten och nu när det är dags för avslutningskonsert bjuds det på en härlig blandad repertoar med allt från gospel, svensk pop, soul, rock och musikal. Kvällens konsert gästas av ingen mindre än fantastiska Uno Svenningsson! Det här kommer att bli en härlig kväll! OM Happy Voices Happy Voices (tidigare Du kan sjunga gospel) startade upp i Stockholm år 2004. Kören finns till för alla som vill vara med och sjunga! Sedan flera år tillbaka finns kören också i Malmö & Göteborg. Happy Voices mål är att vara en öppen, varm, välkomnande, personlig kör där glädje, energi, uppmärksamhet och omsorg står i centrum. Aktuell forskning visar att körsång är friskvård! OM Gabriel Forss Gabriel Forss är en av Sveriges främsta körledare och en folkkär allsångsledare, som sprider glädje över hela landet med sina sångprojekt. Gabriels karriär startade i Melodifestivalen med låten "Bara hon älskar mig" och gruppen Blond, som vann och representerade Sverige i Dublin år 1997. Genom åren har Gabriel varit körledare för soul- och gospelkören "One Voice", programledare för "Förfest hos Gabriel", medverkat i "Körslaget" och "Så ska det låta" samt varit programvärd för "Karlavagnen" i Sveriges Radio m.m. Han har släppt självbiografin "Äntligen" och skivan "Äntligen Jul". OM Uno Svenningsson Uno Svenningsson har en lång och framgångsrik karriär både som…

ai.en: The Sisters of Mercy at Fållan, the defining dark rock band returning to Sweden in November.

events.description: The Sisters of Mercy, a defining act of dark rock, return to Sweden. In November they play a show in Stockholm at Fållan. Andrew Eldritch fronts the band alongside the drum machine Doktor Avalanche. Expect an evening of the band’s danceable, industrial-tinged rock.

ai.en: Tosca at the Royal Swedish Opera, a classic opera about a dramatic 24 hours in Rome.

events.description: Deadly drama, sparkling singing and classic stage design. During a dramatic 24 hours we follow the three main characters in a story of life and death, accompanied by surgingly beautiful music, in a classic performance. Tosca is the opera that has it all, here produced with a grand set design, a large chorus and some of the best loved duets in operatic history.

title.en: Klassisk Måndag: LYSKRAFT. Marika Lagercrantz – actress, Elise Einarsdotter – piano. A musical and poetic concert performance where music intertwines with literary texts.

events.description: The restaurant opens at 6 pm and the concert starts at 8 pm. If you want to have dinner, book a table at www.glennmillercafe.se, otherwise you are welcome to the bar to listen from there. The band plays 3 sets.

ai.en: Joyful Mondays at Yeshin Norbu Meditation Center, with free fika, conversation and meditation each Monday.

events.description: A relaxed space to meet new people and connect awaits every Monday at Yeshin Norbu. Free fika, meaningful conversations and community come together in a welcoming setting. Conversation starters help break the ice, while a guided meditation offers a moment of calm. Join in person or online – no registration required. Everyone is welcome.

ai.en: An opera at Folkoperan in which a teenager named Aisha discovers a powerful voice and is drawn into her own heritage, confronting her father and mother.

events.description: Aisha hears a powerful voice. It is as unreal and beautiful and seductive as it is frightening. Through music, she is drawn into an unknown world far away from the life of a teenager – on a journey deep into her own heritage, where she is forced to confront her father, her mother, and the raging female force – the Queen of the Night, or the Jinn. A musical monologue in Swedish by Bahar Pars, featuring music by Mozart, Puccini, and others. Performed in the foyer of Folkoperan.

Caroline Williams Blues & Soul Trio—featuring Caroline "Soulqueen" Williams (vocals), Erik Svensson (keyboards), and Björn Garefelt (bass)—presents a mix of jazz, blues, and soul, including original songs. Live music starts at 6:00 PM. Free admission.

title.en: Christmas Seafood Table at At Six

ai.en: A Christmas seafood table at Hotel At Six, a modern feast that reworks Swedish holiday traditions.

events.description: A modern, luxurious feast that flips the script on Swedish holiday traditions. Explore a spectacular feast with everything from a premium seafood selection, hot and cold interpretations of the Swedish Christmas classics, sushi, a curated cheese board, and a seriously breathtaking dessert table. When: November 16th – December 24th (Monday to Saturday)

title.en: Israel Galván - La Edad de Oro

ai.en: Israel Galván's La Edad de Oro at Dansens Hus in Stockholm, a flamenco work that has become a cornerstone of his repertoire and is returning two decades after its premiere.

events.description: Flamencovärldens främsta avantgardist Israel Galván är tillbaka på Dansens Hus! Föreställningen La Edad de Oro är ett verk som blivit en hörnsten i Galváns repertoar och satt avtryck världen över. Två decennier efter premiären kan du äntligen se den igen. I "La Edad de Oro" söker Galván inte bara efter flamencons rötter -- han blottlägger dem. Tillsammans med María Marín och Rafael Rodríguez etablerar Galván en scenisk dynamik som fördjupar verkets stringenta karaktär. Genom att skala bort det dekorativa och fokusera på det essentiella uppstår en rå närvaro där kropp, röst och strängar samverkar i ett ofiltrerat uttryck. Föreställningen är inte nostalgisk, utan ett samtida svar på en förlorad form -- en flamenco som brinner, bryter och berör. "For me, it's about surrendering to the silence, with the memory of the guitar and the singing. The dancer's body is a symphony of movements and a musical instrument. 'Edad de Oro' is my personal dance laboratory." -- Israel Galván Föreställningslängd: 1 timme 40 minuter Israel Galván är en banbrytande spansk koreograf och dansare, född i Sevilla i en familj av flamencodansare. Efter klassisk flamencoutbildning har han sedan debuten med verket ¡Mira! / Los zapatos rojos (1998) omformat flamencodansen till ett samtida och gränsöverskridande uttryck. Hans verk präglas av en fysisk dekonstruktion av flamenco, där han lånar rörelseelement från tjurfäktning, fotboll, aktivism och queera scenuttryck. Galván har tilldelats flera…

title.en: Tomten är far till alla barnen

ai.en: Tomten är far till alla barnen, a children's show based on the 1999 cult film, touring Swedish arenas after sold-out runs at Cirkus in Stockholm.

events.description: TOMTEN ÄR FAR TILL ALLA BARNEN Efter utsålda föreställningar, publikens skratt och hyllningar från både kritiker och publik under 2024/2025 på Cirkus i Stockholm, så återvänder nu scensuccén Tomten är far till alla barnen till utvalda arenor i Sverige. När den folkkära kultfilmen från 1999 för första gången tog steget upp på scen 2024 skapades en helt ny svensk jultradition. På scenen fick publiken följa den numera legendariska julaftonen där Sara bjuder hem sina tre ex-män och deras nya familjer för att fira jul tillsammans med sin motvilliga sambo Janne. Det som skulle bli en idyllisk familjehögtid utvecklas snabbt till ett explosivt kaos där gamla relationer, hemligheter och konflikter briserar inför julgranen. Regissören Rikard Bergqvist förvandlade filmens kultförklarade berättelse till en scenföreställning fylld av högt tempo, fysisk komik, musikinslag och en ensemble i absolut toppklass. Kritiker beskrev resultatet som en skrattfest i rasande tempo där publikens första tvekan snabbt byttes mot rungande skratt. Premiären i Stockholm i november 2024 blev startskottet på en publiksuccé. Föreställningen spelade för fulla hus, hyllades av kvällspressen och fortsatte att växa i popularitet under 2025 -- där den bland annat belönades med "Årets scenföreställning" på Svenska Humorpriset. Den hysteriskt roliga, kärleksfullt kaotiska och fullständigt oförutsägbara julaftonen återvänder 2026 med några av Sveriges mest älskade skådespelare. Möt Liv Mjönäs, Linus Wahlgren, Eva…

ai.en: Guldgruvan, a small stand-up comedy club in Sofia Common in Stockholm. Entry is free for those who risk not getting in, and a seated place can be bought.

events.description: Guldgruvan är helt gratis om man vågar ta risken att inte komma in eller få en ståplats, då är de bara att dyka upp. Det man köper här är garanterad sittplats. Guldgruvan är den lilla ståuppklubben med de bästa komikerna, som verkligen levererar när det kommer till klassisk och ärlig stand-up comedy. Det mysiga rummet har vid flera tillfällen liknats med Comedy Cellar i New York och är som gjort för standup comedy shower. Klubben grundades av Simon Gärdenfors och Johannes Brenning och drivs idag av Johannes och Leon Jämtin. Här får du uppleva humor i sin mest autentiska form -- inga filter, bara skarpa skämt och råa skratt. Showerna är i källaren på den lokala krogen Sofia Common som rymmer cirka 70 personer, här får du en intim och nära upplevelse, där både komiker och publik är på samma nivå. Det är en plats där man verkligen känner sig som en del av showen om man önskar. Humor här är ofta direkt, lite utanför boxen och ibland på gränsen -- men alltid genuin. Guldgruvan har blivit känd för att ge plats åt alternativa och okonventionella röster inom stand-up, där nya, experimentella skämt ofta får ta plats på scenen. Så om du gillar stand-up där det inte finns några genvägar, där skrattet kommer från det äkta och lite vågade, då är Guldgruvan stället för dig. Här får du uppleva några av Sveriges bästa komiker på en liten scen, där inget ämne känns för stort eller för litet för att skoja om. Vem som uppträder kommer alltid vara hemligt. Om man vill ha något att äta så kom…

We are pleased to welcome back artist Tobias Måård for a new exhibition. Strata is the plural of the Latin word stratum, meaning a layer or level. In geology, strata are layers of rock and sediment accumulated over long periods of time, each bearing traces of an earlier era. Layers of colour, overpainting, marks, and remnants of previous working processes accumulate on the surface, creating a record of time and transformation. In this sense, the surface becomes an archive of its own making.

events.description: Dungen Det nya Dungen-albumet "Vidrig vår" släpps den 25 september och är en öppen och personlig skildring av en långvarig relations sönderfall. Som första singel från skivan, som hör till det musikaliskt mest nakna de har spelat in, släpps nu "En gång i timmen" -- en låt som både låter omisskännligt Dungen och stakar ut en ny riktning. I höst följer bandet upp albumet med en omfattande Skandinavien-turné med start i Bergen den 22 oktober. Den 20 november spelar bandet på Vasateatern i Stockholm -- biljetterna är släppta! I år är det 25 år sedan Dungen gav ut sitt självbetitlade debutalbum och nya skivan "Vidrig vår", producerad av Gustav Ejstes ihop med trogne vapendragaren Mattias Glavå, är bandets första sedan 2022 års "En är för mycket och tusen aldrig nog". Dungens lika karaktäristiska som dynamiska hybrid av psykrock och folkklanger har trots texter på svenska vunnit dem en månghövdad internationell publik och bland beundrarna märks exempelvis Jack White, Tame Impala och Fleet Foxes. Förutom Gustav Ejstes består Dungen av Reine Fiske (gitarr), Mattias Gustavsson (bas) och Johan Holmegard (trummor). Åldersgräns 18+ http://luger.se www.vasateatern.se
