ai.en: Flamenco Friday at Dansens Hus Studioscen, a flamenco tablao with live performances.

events.description: Flamenco Friday transforms Dansens Hus Studioscen into a tablao, a flamenco stage filled with pure flamenco power. Here, thrilling moments of improvisation meet elaborate compositions, as the artists are swept up in the atmosphere and take the audience into the magical world of flamenco. Visitors can expect lyrical guitar solos, deep singing (cante jondo), and dance filled with rhythm and power. The house band Tres de Corazones has invited fantastic guests to create a sparkling, engaging evening.

ai.en: Free Friday at Moderna Museet, free entry on Friday evenings in spring and autumn from 18:00 to 20:00, with a free guided tour.

events.description: Every Friday evening in spring and autumn, you get free admission to the museum from 18–20. Join a free guided tour of one of the current exhibitions and learn more about the art and the artists.

ai.en: Hobo Comedy at Hobo Stockholm, an evening of stand-up with MC Kathryn LeRoux and DJ Erik Pope.

events.description: Step into a thoughtfully crafted evening of stand-up comedy with MC Kathryn LeRoux and DJ Erik Pope. Expect a rotating lineup of comedians performing in both English and Swedish. Each show unfolds around a theme, giving the night its own personality and flow. Come curious. Stay present. Enjoy a laid-back night that feels intimate, easygoing, and a little unexpected.

title.en: Sta.Demonia Queer Art / Carlos Andrés Díaz

events.description: Welcome to the opening of the exhibition StaDemonia Queer Art: Carlos Andrés Díaz! Come alone or with friends! Carlos Andrés Díaz is a self-taught illustrator presenting his work for the first time. He explores imagery related to queer experiences -themes including shame, introspection, and sexual desire. This exhibition shows a diverse selection of his work from 2026.

ai.en: Trinix, a French DJ duo, at Kollektivet Livet with international club energy in an intimate room.

events.description: International club energy meets an intimate room as French DJ duo Trinix lands at Kollektivet Livet, Stockholm. Blending house, afrobeat and pop, they deliver grooves, big hooks and hands-in-the-air momentum. After a breakout 2025 with the album “Origin” and 1B+ streams, this is a rare chance to catch Trinix up close in a proper club setting.

ai.en: Oyster Friday at Bonnie's in the Bank Hotel, with oysters shucked in the dining room every Friday from 16:00 to 18:00.

events.description: Bonnie’s at Bank Hotel welcomes you to Oyster Friday. Every Friday from 4–6 PM, oysters are freshly shucked in the dining room and served at 12 SEK each. Oyster Friday is the perfect way to start the weekend, whether for an after-work, an early dinner, or simply to enjoy the atmosphere and oysters. Welcome to drop in or book your table.

ai.en: The classic Christmas buffet at Långholmens Wärdshus, a long-running Stockholm tradition.

events.description: Långholmens Wärdshus’s traditional Christmas buffet is a true Stockholm classic that has been a around for many years. Homemade Christmas dishes, prepared using excellent ingredients, are served in a festively decorated 17th-century manor house. The Christmas buffet features around 70 dishes, along with a wide array of delicious accompaniments and Christmas treats.

title.en: Analogue Photography in a Digital Age

events.description: Film-i-Kameran, a group within Enskede Fotoklubb, presents an exhibition of analogue photography. Its fifteen members share a passion for mechanical cameras and traditional and experimental techniques, from pinhole photography to expired film and colour filters. Analogue photography is a tactile craft where patience, experience and chance shape the result. The group meets monthly to share images, discuss techniques, exchange ideas and inspire each other.

title.en: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour - Avicii Arena

ai.en: Westlife 25: The Anniversary World Tour at Avicii Arena, marking the group's 25th year.

events.description: Westlife returns to Stockholm in 2026 with their anniversary tour Westlife 25 – The Anniversary World Tour. The group will perform their biggest hits and new arrangements in a spectacular arena show at Avicii Arena. Expect a night of pop nostalgia, powerful vocals and unforgettable live moments.

title.en: Lane 8 - An evening of music and dance

ai.en: Lane 8 at Bar15, an evening of dance music on the dance floor.

events.description: Lane 8 bjuder in till dansgolv på Bar15. Bra musik, trevligt sällskap och kanske lite klumpiga danssteg. Det är en del av hans This Never Happened-turné, så telefonerna stannar i fickan och musiken får full uppmärksamhet. Kom ensam eller ta med en vän!

title.en: Stadsvandring med Christopher O'Regan - Grändernas hemligheter

ai.en: A city walk in Gamla stan led by Christopher O'Regan, exploring the secrets of the city's old quarters through stories from Swedish history.

events.description: Du har kanske sett honom på TV, där han trollbinder sina tittare med berättelser om Sveriges historia. Med sina gedigna kunskaper och sin eleganta vältalighet levandegör Christopher som ingen annan det förflutna. Nu har Du möjligheten att få uppleva honom livs levande och följa med på en av hans underhållande stadsvandringar i Stockholm. Han har ett kvarts sekels erfarenhet på området, och under hans kunniga och charmerande vägledning får du möta människorna som en gång befolkade de skuggiga kvarteren i Gamla stan. Samlingsplats är på Slottsbacken, vid obelisken. Se på karta: Samlingsplats Barn 0-14 år är välkomna att följa med kostnadsfritt utan biljett. Möt 1700-talets Stockholm på Christopher O'Regans Youtubekanal

ai.en: Italienska vindagen 2026, a day of Italian wines at Grand Hotel in Stockholm, with Swedish importers and producers guiding tastings and travel tips for Italy.

events.description: Varmt välkommen till dagen då du kan prova viner från många av Italiens hörn! Svenska vinimportörer och producenter finns på plats och hjälper dig att hitta dina favoritviner. I år kan du också få tips för en härlig semester i Italien på tema vin & gastronomi. Du kommer även att kunna provsmaka italienska ostar, charkuterier och många andra delikatesser. Matprodukterna går också att handla på plats! Datum: Lördagen 21 november 2026 Tider: Dagen är indelad i 3 pass: kl.12.00 - 14:00 kl.15.00 - 17.00 kl.18.00 - 20.00 Plats: Grand Hotel i Stockholm- Vinterträdgården

ai.en: Anden i glaset 2026 at Gröna Lund, a paranormal illusionist and mentalist's new show.

events.description: After several sold out tours, Paranormal Illusionist & Mentalist Anthony Charles Heads is back with a brand new show this Autumn - Anden I Glaset: 2026. Experience Anthony's unique blend of mentalism, psychological influence, mind reading, "paranormal" demonstrations and inexplicable events in this love letter to Victorian Spiritualism, fake seance and showmanship. Expect to be amazed, confused and maybe a little creeped out. Age limit: 14 years and up.

ai.en: Glaive's God Save The Three show at Fryshuset in Stockholm, with Kurtains as support. Doors at 18:30 and show at 19:30. Ages 13 and over.

events.description: Support: Kurtains Dörrar: 18:30 Show: 19:30 Åldersgräns: 13år

ai.en: Saint Levant's AFANDI World Tour has moved from Fållan to Annexet in Stockholm. Doors at 19:00. Ages 13 and over. Only bags up to A4 size are allowed.

events.description: OBS! Saint Levant byter arena från Fållan till Annexet. Dörrar 19:00 Åldersgräns 13 år Endast väskor i A4-storlek eller mindre får tas med in. Only bags up to A4 size are allowed inside.

title.en: Eric Ericsons kammarkör: Nattsånger – en stund av stillhet

ai.en: Eric Ericsons Kammarkör's Nattsånger concert at Katarina Kyrka in Stockholm, a short programme of quiet music under conductor Olof Boman.

events.description: När dagen går mot sitt slut och tystnaden lägger sig bjuder Eric Ericsons Kammarkör in till en stund att landa i, där tankarna får stillna och musiken blir ett andrum innan natten tar vid. Tillsammans med dirigenten Olof Boman får vi en ljuspunkt i novembermörkret, ett kort program där stillhet, värme och eftertanke står i centrum. Här möts musik från olika tider och traditioner i en gemensam nattlig klangvärld, från medeltidens mystik hos Hildegard von Bingen och Heliga Birgitta, till vår tids meditativa toner hos Arvo Pärt, Paul Mealor och James MacMillan. I programmet ryms också Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdys romantik, den sensuella klangrikedomen hos Jean-Yves Daniel-Lesur och Sven-David Sandströms vibrerande närvaro. Tillsammans bildar de ett stilla flöde av musik, ibland som en viskning, ibland som en varm körklang som fyller rummet. När Eric Ericson grundade Eric Ericsons Kammarkör 1945 lade han grunden till en ensemble som skulle komma att forma svenskt körliv i generationer. Kören har sedan dess etablerat sig som en av världens främsta inom sitt fält. Med en repertoar som sträcker sig från tidig vokalmusik till nutida kompositioner har den blivit känd för sin stilistiska bredd, precision och karakteristiska klang. Program: Paul Mealor: Now Sleeps The Crimson Petal ur Now Sleeps The Crimson Petal Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy: Mitten wir im Leben sind ur Kirchenmusik, Op. 23 Sven-David Sandström: Let him kiss me ur Four Songs of Love Heliga Birgitta: Benedictus sis tu…

Lars Winnerbäck embarks on his first major arena tour since 2023, celebrating 30 years as one of Sweden's most cherished singer-songwriters. Together with his beloved live band, he weaves together old and new songs from his fifteenth album, "Längtan till våren", recorded in southern France. For three decades, his music has given voice to a whole generation's emotions, creating a language entirely his own.

ai.en: Stockholm Smash Fest 2026, Haunted Edition, a two-day badminton tournament on 21 and 22 November at Sollentuna.

events.description: Stockholm Smash Fest 2026 – Haunted Edition is a two-day badminton tournament on 21–22 November at Sollentuna Rackethall. Organized by Stockholm Sports Familj (SSF), it features Men’s, Women’s and Mixed Doubles across different skill levels. Expect exciting matches, a fun Halloween-inspired atmosphere and a welcoming community spirit. Players, families and spectators are all welcome to join the action!

Discover The Other Side Market’s Christmas market at Winterviken. Meet over 50 makers and find unique Christmas gifts in the beautiful upstairs hall, Stora Salen. Enjoy lunch, coffee and Swedish fika at the restaurant, then explore the scenic surroundings. Free entry.

ai.en: Gershwin to Bernstein at the Royal Swedish Opera, the grand finale of the orchestra's 500th anniversary celebrations.

events.description: As the grand finale to the Royal Swedish Orchestra’s 500th anniversary celebrations, the main stage will come alive with colourful, energetic orchestral music from the USA. Alan Gilbert conducts.

ai.en: Rigoletto Speciale at Bromma Musikscen, Victor Hugo's text blended with music from Verdi's opera.

events.description: Rigoletto Speciale blends Victor Hugo’s original texts with music from G. Verdi’s opera Rigoletto. Much of the atmosphere in F. Piave’s libretto to Rigoletto has been lost. The version presented is based on Hugo’s play *Le Roi s’amuse* / *The King Amuses Himself*. Many consider Rigoletto to be the world’s best opera.

ai.en: Curious about Space, a concert by the Lönneberga Quartet inspired by meeting the astronaut Christer Fuglesang, at Katarina församlingshus.

events.description: Curious about Outer Space. Inspired by meeting the astronaut Christer Fuglesang, the Lönneberga Quartet has created a family performance for all ages. The music dreams and swings through 14 billion years - Star Wars, Strauss, facts, and dreams, as well as stories from the quartet's meeting with Sweden's first astronaut. Free admission. Language - Swedish.

The Christmas Market on Stortorget in Stockholm’s Old Town has 41 stalls and everything you need for a real Christmas atmosphere! Crafts and ceramics, sausages and game meat, art forging, caramels, cotton candy, and much more. And mulled wine, of course!

Make a day of it at the farm! Enjoy a coffee break and hunt for unique finds at the lovely indoor flea market in Logen. Why not treat yourself to something freshly baked from the bakery while you're there?

ai.en: A beer walk on Södermalm, visiting four pubs and tasting five beers.

events.description: During Taysta's beer walk on Södermalm, you will wander between 4 different pubs and try 5 different beers. Throughout the tour, you will also be accompanied by a beer master who will give all his best tips and tricks along the way. Learn more about the beers you try and everything else related to beer. It will be a fun way to discover new places in beautiful Södermalm. The perfect excursion for all beer lovers!

ai.en: Vinterdrömmar, Repliken's first Christmas show at Folkets hus in Tumba, a festive afternoon.

events.description: Welcome to Vinterdrömmar (Winter Dreams) – Repliken’s very first Christmas show! Enjoy a warm and festive afternoon filled with Christmas music, humour, entertainment and unexpected Christmas chaos. Take a seat at a beautifully decorated Christmas table and enjoy Afternoon Tea while Repliken’s ensemble and live band fill Segersjö Folkets hus in Tumba with music, laughter and festive cheer. Your ticket includes the show and Afternoon Tea. Come and celebrate the Christmas season!

ai.en: Saint Levant's Afandi world tour at Fållan, a Palestinian singer and rapper blending funk, rock and hip hop.

events.description: Saint Levant is a Palestinian singer and rapper known for blending funk, rock, hip-hop, and rhythm and blues with traditional Palestinian and Algerian rhythms. He is recognized for his multilingual music and has gained global fame with tracks like 'Very Few Friends'. The concert at Fållan in Stockholm is part of his AFANDI WORLD TOUR.

"Taylor Swift, our Mastermind, brought us together with the very first Swiftie club in Sweden EVER… and somehow, 5 years later, we’re still bejeweled together on the dancefloor. Join us for a whole evening of Taylor magic. Expect heartbreak anthems, fearless dancing, champagne problems, glitter, chaos, and memories that will last forevermore. So make the friendship bracelets, gather your fellow Swifties, and come celebrate 5 years of being enchanted together."

title.en: Who stole the Lovely Garden from the Goose?

events.description: Konst i förskolan is a long-standing collaboration between Farsta stadsdelsförvaltning and Konsthall C. Every year, all 5-year olds at Farsta’s municipal preschools participate, making it one of Sweden’s largest exhibitions by and for kids. Since over a decade, thousands of young children have entered the gallery as artists. In this year's edition the children become geese in a massive musical installation.

title.en: Tätt intill – Jazz and Poetry in Swedish

ai.en: Tätt intill, a jazz and poetry concert in Swedish at Teater Bristol with Stefan Forssén on piano.

events.description: Jazz and poetry meet in Tätt intill, a poetry concert featuring Stefan Forssén on piano and Maria af Malmborg performing vocals and spoken verse. Forssén has composed new music for poems by Bob Hansson, Eva-Stina Byggmästar, Bruno K. Öijer and Göran Sonnevi. Piano, voice and words form a stage experience in which jazz carries, comments on and sometimes challenges the poetry. The performance is in Swedish.

ai.en: Mustaschmilen at Solvalla on 21 November, a running event.

events.description: On November 21, Mustaschmilen takes place at Solvalla in Stockholm! A running event bringing people together in the fight against prostate cancer. Choose between 5 or 10 km, or join the 1 km children's race. Whether you prefer to run, jog or walk, everyone is welcome. Join us in making a difference for men's health – every step counts!

title.en: Christmas at Gröna Lund Amusement Park

ai.en: Barnens Jul, a Christmas world at Gröna Lund amusement park, as the park launches its winter season.

events.description: Groena Lund is launching a brand-new winter season with Barnens Jul, a magical Christmas world in the amusement park's Lilla Område. Children can experience ice shows with the Ice Queen, Christmas candy, illuminated rides, Christmas music, ice skating shows, Gnutt performances, and meet Santa, Mrs. Santa, and the elves.

title.en: Desi Dhamaal Vol. 3: Tadka Rewired – Indian Dance Show and Bollywood Party

events.description: Desi Dhamaal is an Indian dance show and Bollywood party in Stockholm, now in its third edition, Tadka Rewired. Dancers from the Stockholm scene perform Bollywood, Bhangra, Kathak, Silambam, hip-hop and desi fusion pieces created for the night. DJ Ron closes the evening with Bollywood and Punjabi hits, and Indian street food is served on site. The show is organised by the dance collective Prerna Kalakaar and is open to all ages. Tickets and the full lineup are on the event website.

title.en: Tigers - Inspired by the Books about Loranga, Masarin and Dartanjang by Barbro Lindgren (2.5-6 years)

ai.en: Tigers, a Teater Tre children's show based on the Loranga, Masarin and Dartanjang books, an adventure through a forest.

events.description: Join an adventure through the forest, past the scrap yard and the giraffe, to Masarin’s home. Dad Loranga sleeps under the kitchen table, Grandpa Dartanjang takes his temperature in the woodshed – but what is that rumbling in the distance? Tigers! Are they dangerous or funny? Tigers roar, stars twinkle, and the summer never ends. Let yourself be swept away by tiger hunts, pretend bullfights and car races in this physical comedy about being strong, scared and almost happy.

ai.en: A wheel-throwing pottery workshop at The Creativity House, for beginners in individual, couple or small-group sessions.

events.description: Learn to wheel-throw in a mixed group. Suitable for individuals, couples, or small groups. Beginner level – but anyone who's thrown on a wheel before is also warmly welcome! A pottery instructor will guide you and help you during the entire session, step by step. Make, for example, a bowl, cup, candle holder, etc. You get unlimited tries and can keep 3 pieces per person.

title.en: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour
title.fr: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour
title.nl: Bryson Tiller Presents: The Neo Trapsoul Tour

ai.en: Bryson Tiller's Neo Trapsoul tour at Avicii Arena, by the GRAMMY-nominated artist from Louisville.

events.description: Bryson Tiller is a GRAMMY-nominated multi-platinum artist from Louisville, Kentucky, renowned for his breakout diamond-certified hit "Don’t" and the groundbreaking album T R A P S O U L (2015), which helped define modern trap R&B. His follow-up, True to Self (2017), debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. The Neo Trapsoul Tour celebrates the 10-year anniversary of T R A P S O U L.

ai.en: Sofia HK at Debaser Nova, returning after her debut album I Norr.

events.description: A Debaser favorite returns this fall! Following last year’s acclaimed debut I Norr and not one but two visits to Debaser, Sofia HK is finally releasing her first full-length album, Flocken. The release will be celebrated at Nova on November 22, and if you haven’t already discovered this folk singer from Jämtland, whose songs speak straight to the listener’s heart, now is the time. Named one of “Sweden’s next big names in music” by GAFFA.

title.en: Autumn concert in the Blue Hall: Kali Malone

ai.en: Kali Malone's autumn concert in the Blue Hall at Stockholm City Hall, by the acclaimed organist and composer.

events.description: Internationally acclaimed organist and composer Kali Malone comes to Stockholm City Hall for this year’s autumn concert. Her minimalist music will meet Ragnar Östberg’s magnificent architecture and the rich sound of the City Hall Organ. An autumn evening for those who want to experience music up close in one of Stockholm’s most unique settings.

title.en: Christer Lyssarides & Bengan Jonasson & Markku Reinikainen musical séance @ Akkurat

events.description: Come experience a musical séance – a Swedish-Finnish-Cypriot co-production featuring guitarist Christer Lyssarides, Bengan Jonasson (electric bass), and Markku Reinikainen (drums).

title.en: Car boot sale in Kista galleria parking garage

ai.en: A large car boot sale in the parking garage of Kista galleria, where Stockholmers sell second-hand clothes, vintage, toys and antiques.

events.description: Huge car boot sale at Kista galleria's parking garage (Östra p-huset). Come find your own true treasures among car loads of things at this very very popular flea market where Stockholmers can come and sell what they no longer need. From second hand clothes to vintage, from toys to antiques! Come early - or late for best bargain potential!

ilDance Event - 3rd edition: a Gaga/people class.A sharing of process from a multidisciplinary performance project exploring healing, control, and the political economy of care. A sharing of process from a performance built around the physical and psychological reality of an athletes’ training camp, centered on repetition, exhaustion, preparation, doubt, pain, anticipation, and recovery. An artist talk and a soft party with a DJ.

The legendary ensemble Södra Bergens Balalajkor, with 56 years on stage, returns to Stallet – bringing with them a kaleidoscope of tones, rhythms, and stories from both near and far. Here, Evert Taube rubs shoulders with Joseph Haydn, the Carpathians meet the archipelago, and far off in the distance, the Dnieper flows slowly by. It is lively, it is playful, it is Södra Bergens Balalajkor!

ai.en: CABAL and Employed To Serve at Kollektivet Livet, a co-headline show of metalcore and thrash.

events.description: CABAL and Employed To Serve are coming to Stockholm for a co-headline show. Employed To Serve combine metalcore, thrash and groove with soaring melodies, while CABAL deliver pitch-black deathcore rooted in death metal, hardcore and electronic music. Danish band Cold Culture open the night with their emotionally charged, electronic-infused post-hardcore.

ai.en: Gula Änglarna's winter concert 2026 at Oscarskyrkan in Stockholm, with Tomas Ledin, Helen Sjöholm, Anna Stadling, Lena Endre and Gladys del Pilar, with proceeds going to people living in homelessness.

events.description: Gula Änglarnas årliga vinterkonsert i Oscarskyrkan med Tomas Ledin, Helen Sjöholm, Anna Stadling, Lena Endre och Gladys del Pilar tillsammans med gospelkören Gladness. Konserten hålls till förmån för Gula Änglarnas verksamhet. Hela behållningen går oavkortat till människor som lever i hemlöshet, ungdomar & pensionärer i svårt utsatta situationer. Insläppstid: 18:00 Längd: 85 min Julkonsert

ai.en: KAJ at Göta Lejon in Stockholm, a show by the band behind the 2025 hit Bara Bada Bastu. No age limit.

events.description: Konserten arrangeras av FKP Scorpio Åldersgräns: Ingen åldersgräns ------------------------------------------------------ Om 2025 hade ett soundtrack så stavades det "Bara Bada Bastu". Det som började som en bastudoftande, glimt-i-ögat-hyllning till nordisk kultur exploderade till ett fullskaligt popfenomen. "Bara Bada Bastu" sköt rakt upp till #1 på Spotify i både Sverige och Finland och toppade listor över hela Norden och Baltikum -- för att sedan ta klivet ut i världen med en raketstart på Spotify Global och #1 på Viral 50 Global. Och som ett extra vedträ i en redan ångande het bastu blev låten nominerad till en Grammis. Bakom succén KAJ står trion Kevin Holmström, Axel Åhman och Jakob Norrgård -- uppvuxna i Vörå i Finland, där allt började redan 2009. Med kvicka texter, nostalgiska flirtar och en varm kärlek till den finlandssvenska kulturen byggde de tidigt en egen musikalisk värld baserad på lika delar nordiska folkmelodier, modern pop och scenisk humor. Det lokala blev snabbt nationellt. Och därefter internationellt. Resan har kantats av utsålda turnéer, album och en historisk seger i Melodifestivalen 2025, där KAJ blev den första finlandssvenska akten att representera Sverige i Eurovision. Nu väntar en ny Sverigeturné. Och KAJ tänker inte göra någon halvmesyr. Räkna med allsång som lyfter taket, koreografier du inte visste att du kunde, bastuvärme i novembermörkret och en show där humor går hand i hand med hitkänsla.

ai.en: Team Putte with guest Evelina Gard at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm, a gospel, pop and soul concert celebrating Gard's 25 years as an artist.

events.description: Välkommen till en konsert med Team Putte! Kören som sjunger gospel, pop, soul och någon visa. Det blir en blandning av låtar där förhoppningsvis flera av dem ska passa dina öron. Den här gången har vi med oss gästartisten Evelina Gard som i år firar 25 år som artist. Evelina har genom åren släppt flera album, lett körer, haft sångelever samt skrivit och arrangerat musik. Vi är så glada att Evelina är med oss den här kvällen och vi ska göra vårt bästa för att detta ska bli en kväll att minnas.

Ruth Kvarnström-Jones, Denise Rudberg and Mari Jungstedt come together at Rival in Stockholm for a special evening of conversation and literature. Join us for an evening with three of Sweden’s most widely read and beloved authors as they talk about their latest books, the characters that bring their stories to life, and the worlds they simply can’t stop writing about. The evening will be hosted by journalist Titti Schultz.

Welcome to Dark Mode, a new author event for anyone fascinated by crime fiction, mysteries, and stories that keep you awake long past bedtime. During the evening, you’ll meet Lina Areklew, Lina Bengtsdotter, Ida Axelsson & Åsa Bonelli, Jenny Rogneby, Malcolm Lidbeck and Kicki Sehlstedt. After the talks, you’ll have the opportunity to meet the authors, buy their books, and have them signed.
Enjoy a culinary journey where Swedish Christmas classics meet flavors from around the world, with hot favorites, cold delicacies and desserts from La Botanicas very own bakery.

title.en: Sjung för mig Arja! Sa Mikis

ai.en: Sjung för mig Arja! at Oscarsteatern, an evening with Arja Saijonmaa on peace, freedom and democracy.

events.description: Arja Saijonmaa bjuder in till en kväll som börjar på vita duken och slutar på scen. En kväll för fred, frihet och demokrati. Dokumentärfilmen ”Sjung för mig Arja!” (regi: Marko Talli) tecknar ett nära porträtt av hennes liv och hennes livslånga vänskap med Mikis Theodorakis. Efter filmen kliver Arja upp på scen och bjuder på en konsert.

ai.en: beabadoobee's The Powerlines tour at Fryshuset, the Filipino-British singer-songwriter.

events.description: Beabadoobee, also known as Beatrice Kristi Ilejay Laus, is a Filipino-British singer-songwriter renowned for her unique blend of indie, alternative pop, and 90s-inspired rock. She gained fame with her song "Coffee", which went viral on TikTok and was later sampled in Powfu’s "Death Bed (Coffee for Your Head)". She has released critically acclaimed albums such as *Fake It Flowers* and *Beatopia*, and her latest album *This Is How Tomorrow Moves* topped the UK charts. The concert is part of her "The Powerlines Tour".

title.en: Christmas Dining Cruise in Stockholm Archipelago 2026

events.description: Experience a magical Christmas aboard our archipelago ships. Choose between lunch or dinner cruises and enjoy high-quality Swedish traditional Christmas buffets. Select the boat that best suits you and your friends!

title.en: Children of the Forest (1–3 years old)

events.description: Children of the Forest, freely inspired by Elsa Beskow’s beloved tale, is a joyful celebration of a young child’s world through the changing seasons. As we grow, play and explore, we discover ourselves, each other and the magic of everyday life. A bold, techno-infused visual performance for ages 1–3 and their grown-ups, celebrating curiosity, connection and the joy of being together.

title.en: Riche Fenix x Lennart & Bror Fisk

events.description: Mark your calendars for Tuesday, November 24, as it’s time for the next guest chef takeover at Riche Fenix! Riche Fenix are delighted to welcome the team from Lennart & Bror Fisk for an evening celebrating delicious flavours from the sea and a wonderful atmosphere.

ai.en: Spelmansmusik at Åsen, a traditional music concert series at Hägerstensåsens medborgarhus this autumn.

events.description: This concert series presenting traditional music offers something old, something new, raw and beautiful. Distorted strings and tender words, blue notes and polskas, soup, and true analogue kinship. A warm welcome to four Tuesday evenings at Hägerstensåsens Medborgarhus – Stockholm’s finest living room for imagination and tradition. CONCERTS: 29/9 Annas Blå + Erlend Apneseth 27/10 Cinna Peyghamy + Totte Mattsson 24/11 Diket + Hanna & Robin 8/12 Nadin & Cassius + Verf-Lena & Kristina Ståhl

ai.en: Omah Lay at Fållan, a Nigerian singer and producer known for Afro-fusion.

events.description: Omah Lay is a Nigerian singer, songwriter, and producer known for his unique Afro-fusion style. He rose to fame in 2020 with his debut EP *Get Layd*, which topped the Nigerian charts and included hit singles like 'Bad Influence' and 'You'. His music blends elements of Afrobeat, soul, and R&B, and he has been praised for his distinctive vocals and introspective lyrics. Omah Lay has also collaborated with international artists like Justin Bieber, further establishing himself as one of Africa’s most promising talents.

events.description: Meet Nelio Biedermann in conversation with Cecilia Hansson. Join him on International Writers' Stage November International Writers' Stage for a conversation about the book.

The film tells the story of American disability rights activist Judy Heumann and the other activists who occupied a federal building in San Francisco in 1977.After the film, there will be a public discussion, offering an opportunity to reflect on the film.The event is free, but you register by emailing info@cilsweden.se. When registering, please write if you need sign language interpretation, audio description, assistance from the metro station, or anything else the organizer should know.The film is in English with Swedish subtitles. If you wish, the subtitles can be read aloud by the audio describer.Folkets Hus in Bagarmossen is wheelchair accessible and equipped with a hearing loop.

What Was That? is a colourful performance for children aged 0–3 at Teater Bristol in Sundbyberg. Through music, play and a touch of excitement, little ones explore the magic of the seasons with all their senses. Sign-supported communication enhances the experience. The 20-minute show is followed by 20 minutes of music, play and movement. Note: the show is in Swedish.

ai.en: Swan Lake with a live orchestra, performed by International Festival Ballet at Göta Lejon in Stockholm.

events.description: International Festival Ballet presenterar en av de mest kända baletterna till musiken av Pjotr Iljitj Tjajkovskijs "Svansjön". För många är "Svansjön" synonymt med balett. Den romantiska sagan om den unge prinsen Siegfried, som förälskar sig i svanprinsessan Odetta och vill befria henne från hertig Rothbarts onda förtrollning, är en berättelse om den sanna kärlekens kraft. Detta balettstycke ingår i standardrepertoaren hos alla större kompanier. I synnerhet Allegro Moderato från Svanedanserna i akt 2, koreograferad av Lev Ivanov, har varit föremål för otaliga parodier och är därför känd långt utanför den balettintresserade allmänheten som "De fyra små svanarnas dans". Kort sagt är det ett genialt verk av en genialisk kompositör och har varit en publikdragare i århundraden. "Svansjön" trollas fram på scenen av en av de bästa klassiska balettensemblerna, International Festival Ballet. Den grandiosa scenografin av den briljante teaterdesignern Vjatscheslav Okunev, som bl.a. arbetat för Mariinskijteatern i S:t Petersburg och La Scala i Milano, vackra kostymer och balettensemblens gränslösa elegans och bekymmerslösa lätthet ger dessutom en drömsk och sagolik version av en klassisk balett som fortsätter att fascinera även efter mer än 100 år. International Festival Ballet Ensemble dansar vidare Sedan sommaren 2022 har St Petersburg Festival Ballet ett nytt namn. Chockad och påverkad av Rysslands omänskliga angreppskrig mot Ukraina byter den välrenommerade balettensemblen namn till…

events.description: The short films are returning to cinemas! During the fall of 2026, Svensk Kortfilm c/o Folkets Bio offers some of the best short films, noticed and shown at film festivals around the world. ai.en: Andersson Dance's ORE at Dansens Hus Blackbox, a dance work by Örjan Andersson inspired by Romantic painters such as Friedrich, Turner and Delacroix.

events.description: I ORE tar Örjan Andersson avstamp i landskapet och naturen för att reflektera över människans relation till sin omgivning och de förändringar den genomgår. Med inspiration från romantikens konstnärer -- Caspar David Friedrich, J.M.W. Turner och Eugène Delacroix -- riktas blicken mot både naturens storslagenhet och människans påverkan på den. Genom ljudkonstnären, fältinspelaren och tonsättaren BJ Nilsens inspelningar färdas verket mellan vitt skilda miljöer: från de suggestiva bergslandskapen i Alpe Djouan till de mörka gruvgångarna i Kirkenes bergsmassiv, där damm, sten och industri präglar både landskap och livsvillkor. Här är gruvdriften i full gång med en fullkomligt färglös värld. Dammet ligger tungt och endast olika monokromatiska toner av grått och svart syns över gruvarbetarnas fotavtryck. I scenografen och ljusdesignern Chrisander Bruns gestaltning omformas dessa miljöer till artificiella landskap och rum där nya berättelser kan ta form. Längd: 60 min. OM ÖRJAN ANDERSSON Örjan Andersson är en av Sveriges mest framgångsrika koreografer med över 30 verk bakom sig där han har skapat beställningsverk för flera av de ledande kompanierna i Sverige och Europa och för det egna kompaniet Andersson Dance. De senaste åren har han även arbetat för teaterscenen och gjort succé med sin regi av Werther på Unga Dramaten, Hamlet på Folkteatern i Göteborg, Drottningens juvelsmycke på Helsingborgs Stadsteater och med Orfeus & Eurydike på Unga på Operan.

title.en: Master Boot Record & Fulci + Support: Arottenbit

Master Boot Record blends heavy riffs with synths and computer-driven aesthetics, while Fulci delivers raw, horror-inspired death metal rooted in classic Italian splatter cinema. ai.en: Capture the City, an urban sketching workshop at the Spårvägsmuseet, drawing rusty boxes, drains and old trams.

events.description: A rusty utility box, a forgotten street drain, an old tram: for urban sketchers, everything deserves to be immortalized. Nina Johansson teaches you the basics of urban sketching, the art of capturing the city one quick sketch at a time. After a short introduction, the participants draw in the museum's exhibitions with the metro as our theme, and finish by adding color to the sketches together. No drawing experience needed. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

title.en: Talk: New Modes of Transport - E-scooters, Car Sharing and Self-Driving Taxis

ai.en: A talk on new ways of getting around: e-scooters, car sharing and self-driving cars, at the Spårvägsmuseet.

events.description: A row of e-scooters on the pavement, a car-sharing app you forgot you had, and cars that drive themselves. The way we get around the city is constantly changing, but what will become everyday life and what is just a passing trend? This talk looks at how e-scooters, bicycles and car sharing already work with public transport, and what self-driving technology could mean in the long run, with examples from Stockholm and around the world. Talk, 1 hour. At Spårvägsmuseet, tickets required.

events.description: Embark on a journey into the world of horses. Follow wild herds galloping across vast landscapes, meet legendary desert stallions renowned for their speed, and get up close to working horses that remain calm even under great pressure. Meet miniature horses whose presence provides comfort and support to people. Through these encounters, Horse Power reveals the remarkable versatility of horses, from their raw power and speed to their intelligence, courage, and ability to form emotional bonds.

title.en: Swedish Christmas Buffet in the Stockholm Archipelago

ai.en: A Swedish Christmas buffet at Sandhamn Seglarhotell in the Stockholm archipelago.

events.description: Discover the flavours of Christmas at Sandhamn Seglarhotell in the Stockholm archipelago. The Swedish Christmas buffet brings together traditional favourites and new flavours: pickled herring, fish and seafood, cold cuts and warm festive dishes. A wide range of plant-based options is also available, from aubergine “herring” to meatballs and Jansson’s gratin. The meal is finished with cheeses, desserts and sweets. Welcome glögg and coffee are included.

events.description: Ellery House's resident music curators, Charlie King & Caspar Camitz, move between the tables, making music part of the experience – with you, around you, and for you. Think Stevie Wonder, soul, and songs everyone seems to know by heart. Elegant, entertaining, and just unexpected enough.

events.description: One Thursday evening a month, we keep the museum open with free admission. Stay tuned, we'll be updating the program regularly.

events.description: Warmly welcome to Luzette this Christmas and experience the flavours and traditions of a French Christmas, with the finest seafood at the heart of the menu. During several rounds take on the roles of bartender and jury and create your own cocktails during a little competition.

title.en: Jenny Axelsson: Free Fall – On the Courage to Let Go

events.description: On Nov 26, Jenny Axelsson opens her solo exhibition Free Fall – On the Courage to Let Go at Galleri 86, Södermalm. Her paintings explore life’s big leaps, uncertainty, and trust. ”Letting go is hard with no guarantees, but we must dare. I want to inspire visitors to take that leap,” says Jenny.

ai.en: Gurriers at Debaser Nova on 26 November, a European indie band with new music.

events.description: Gurriers have quickly become a name to reckon with on the European indie scene, and on November 26 they bring their new album Nobody’s Coming To Save You to Debaser Nova. Since their 2024 debut Come and See, the milestones have kept coming one after another. Now it’s time for the next chapter as the band releases their second record, Nobody’s Coming To Save You.

title.en: BLANACE and BERNS presents PAUL VAN DYK & ORJAN NILSEN!

Med en karriär som format hela den globala trance-scenen har Paul van Dyk gång på gång visat varför han räknas som en av de mest inflytelserika DJ:s och producenterna genom tiderna. Som support välkomnar vi även Ørjan Nilsen, en tung kraft inom den melodiska och energiska trance-scenen, känd för sina kraftfulla produktioner och intensiva liveset. Det här blir en kväll för alla som älskar stora känslor, mäktiga drops och den där unika känslan som bara trance kan skapa. - Åldersgräns: 20 år Insläppstid: 22:30

events.description: MALL CALL is a groundbreaking festival focused on electronic dance music and contemporary club culture. Welcome to Mall Call at Stinsen, Sollentuna, on November 27--28 Club culture has always had a talent for seeing possibilities where others see limitations. Warehouses become dancefloors, forests become raves, abandoned buildings become temporary worlds of their own. Some of the most memorable nights happen in places that were never designed for music in the first place. In November, Mall Call continues that tradition by taking over Stinsen, a vast abandoned shopping mall in Sollentuna, just outside Stockholm. Across 30,000 square metres of empty stores, corridors and forgotten retail spaces, commerce gives way to culture. Electronic artists, visual art, bars and unexpected club spaces move into the building. A former optician might become a wine bar. An empty storefront might turn into an intimate dancefloor. A forgotten corridor might lead somewhere you never expected. The mall becomes more than a venue. It becomes a place to explore, get lost in and experience differently. The mall is closed. title.en: Jag är Carola - En musikalisk livsberättelse

ai.en: Carola's Jag är Carola, a musical life story at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm, held to mark her 60th birthday and the launch of her first book.

events.description: Carola kommer till Filadelfiakyrkan med "Jag är Carola -- en musikalisk unik livsberättelse". Den 8 september, i samband med sin 60-årsdag, släpper Carola Häggkvist sin första bok. I självbiografin Jag är Carola, som skildrar uppväxten och hennes liv fram till 2002, berättar Carola för första gången någonsin sin egen historia. Som en förlängning av boksläppet står det nu klart att hon i höst även åker ut på en omfattande Nordenturné för att möta sin publik. Tillsammans med pianisten Will Oaks kommer Carola att ge över 30 konserter i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Island och Färöarna och där debutboken står i centrum. När hon genom musik och berättelser delar med sig av de låtar och händelser som format henne blir det enligt henne själv både "intimt och nära men framförallt väldigt exklusivt" när hon framför låtar som man kanske inte vanligen hör på en Carola-konsert som exempelvis "Krokodilbarnets klagan" och "If I Can Dream" av Elvis Presley varvat med hennes största hits såsom "Främling", "Säg mig var du står" och "Fångad av en stormvind". I över fyra decennier har Carola varit en av Sveriges i särklass största stjärnor. Sedan det sensationella genombrottet med "Främling" 1983 har hon blivit en självklar del av Sveriges kulturella arv och har sedan dess levt ett liv i offentlighetens blickfång. Nu öppnar hon dörren till ett liv som länge skildrats av andra -- och berättar själv om människan bakom artisten i en nära och exklusiv konsertupplevelse.

title.en: Asteroid defence: can we defend Earth?

ai.en: Asteroid defence: can we defend Earth?, a talk at Tekniska museet on the asteroid Apophis passing close to Earth in 2029.

events.description: On 13 April 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass closer to Earth than our geostationary satellites. ai.en: RITSCH RATSCH på Vasan, a Christmas show at Vasateatern in Stockholm with Helen Sjöholm, Jacke Sjödin, Sussie Eriksson, Andreas Nilsson and a five-piece band.

events.description: Välkommen till RITSCH RATSCH på Vasan, en julshow som vänder upp och ned på alla julshower du tidigare skådat! Helen Sjöholm, Jacke Sjödin, Sussie Eriksson, Andreas Nilsson och Mikael Skoglunds 5-mannaband bjuder på en julshow av aldrig tidigare skådat slag. Det blir jul med extra allt och ett kärleksfullt, musikaliskt fyrverkeri kring den svenska julsångskatten! Det blir julsånger som dissekeras och analyseras. Det blir jultexter på helt andra melodier. Det blir julvisor där vi får veta vad som hände efter originaltextens slut. Det blir en uppgörelse med den labile sockerbagaren. Det blir julspel. Det blir luciatåg. Det blir berättelser om hur "Uppå källarbacken" uppstod. Det blir Bjällerklang från hela jordens mörka rund. Det blir 36 klassiska julsånger på tre minuter. Det blir Rudolf med röda mulen som nyskriven, svulstig musikal. Och mycket, mycket, mycket annat. Det blir kort sagt sång, musik, dans, trams och allvar i en salig blandning. Ungefär som ett julbord med allt från vörtbröd till marsipangris. Spelas på Vasateatern i Stockholm 4-20/12 2026 Åldersgräns 13 år

ai.en: Crash Nomada and Big Fish at Debaser Nova, a co-headline show of folk punk and alternative rock.

events.description: Crash Nomada’s borderless folk punk meets Big Fish’s dark and uncompromising alternative rock in a co-headline show that brings together two of the Swedish alternative scene’s most distinctive live bands.
Lucia Rituals is a concert experience featuring traditional Lucia music at Engelska kyrkan. The event focuses on the Swedish Lucia tradition with choral singing and classic Christmas melodies.

title.en: Christmas market at the Royal Stables 2026

ai.en: A Christmas market at the Royal Stables on the second weekend of Advent, with exhibitors from across Sweden.

events.description: This year's Christmas market is held at the Royal Stables on the second weekend of Advent. Exhibitors from across Sweden will be selling the finest quality crafts. The stables, harness room and coach sheds will also be open all weekend.

title.en: Between Light and Form – Slavka Velitchkova

events.description: Between Light and Form is a solo exhibition of paintings by artist Slavka Velitchkova. The exhibition presents works in oil on canvas, exploring the interplay between colour, form and pictorial space. Through landscapes, figures and still lifes, the artist examines how painting can move beyond literal representation. The exhibition offers an insight into a personal approach to painting, with light, texture and composition at its core.

ai.en: [ingenting] at Debaser Strand, celebrating 20 years since their 2006 album Mycket väsen för ingenting.

events.description: 20 years of Punkdrömmar! Indie legends [ingenting] (Swedish: [nothing]) are releasing their 2006 album Mycket väsen för ingenting on vinyl for the very first time, celebrating with a release party at Debaser Strand on December 4. Expect red wine in your glass, the roof to be raised, and both new and long-dormant punk dreams to come alive.

title.en: Kristian Wiik Band at Sofia Common

events.description: An evening of Swedish-language pop with a touch of blues and a hint of 1960s schlager! Kristian Wiik Band is a quartet playing their own songs about life and the moods that come with it, told with three chords or more. Come early for food in the restaurant, then head down to the cellar for an evening of live music.

ai.en: Babblarna and Klonks Klapp-kalas at Nya Cirkus, a new interactive musical for the youngest children.

events.description: Babblarna & Klonks Klapp-kalas is a brand new interactive musical for the youngest featuring the immensely popular Babblarna figures.

Välkommen till Vinterölsträff i Stockholm med provsmakning och domarbedömning av hembryggd öl. Medlemsbiljett gäller endast medlemmar i Svenska hembryggareföreningen. Mer information: www.shbf.se. Åldersgräns 20 år. Barn får ej tas med.

ai.en: KVAH's traditional Christmas concert at Allhelgonakyrkan in Stockholm, with soprano Elin Rombo, baritone Jakob Högström, organist Joakim Elevant and pianist Bengt Forsberg. Free entry for visitors under 26.

events.description: Klassiska julsånger och överraskningar med Elin Rombo -- sopran, Jakob Högström -- baryton, Joakim Elevant -- orgel, Bengt Forsberg -- piano och vokalensemble ur Katarina Kammarkör Garanterat hög stämning! Gratis entré för besökare under 26 år. Biljetter säljs via Ticketmaster. Finns platser kvar på konsertdagen säljs de för samma pris vid entrén från kl 17.30. Vi kan ta emot betalning med kreditkort, Swish och kontanter. Onumrerat, insläpp kl 17.30.

ai.en: Fredrik Benke Rydman's Romeo & Julia at Stora Scen in Stockholm, a version of Shakespeare's story about love in an age of AI companions.

events.description: Om "riktig" kärlek i AI:ns tid -- Benke är tillbaka med kärleks-klassiker! I Fredrik "Benke" Rydmans tolkning av Shakespeares Romeo & Julia tar han klassikern in i en värld där vi matar vårt behov av kärlek med AI. Med en AI-partner är ingenting besvärligt och alla behov blir tillfredsställda. I en tid där äkta kärlek saknas, så kan hatet växa. När Romeo & Julia träffas uppstår något helt annat, något de aldrig varit med om, kärlek som berusar. Som gör ont och som smärtar. Men tänk om hon inte är äkta? Om kärleken inte är äkta? Då vill han inte leva längre. Kärleken till henne gör honom sjuk och han måste få veta om hon är på riktigt. Det enda sättet är kanske att döda henne? Alla vet hur historien slutar, men vet du hur riktig kärlek kan kännas? Föreställningslängd: 75 min
Klicka här för att läsa mer om föreställningen

ai.en: Mind Enterprises, the aesthetic and musical world of the Turin-raised producer Andrea Tirone.

events.description: Mind Enterprises is the aesthetic universe and musical dreamworld of Turin-raised producer Andrea Tirone. Drawing from the fizzy, synth-powered Italo that defined the era, he combines groovy, disco-adjacent basslines, hypnotic drum patterns, and cosmic keyboard odysseys that traverse continents.

ai.en: Terra at B-K in Stockholm. Doors at 19:00 and start at 20:00. Ages 18 and over, with a limited number of tickets for ages 13 to 18.

events.description: Dörrar 19:00 Start 20:00 Åldergräns 18+ men ett begränsat antal som enbart gäller för dig mellan 13-18 år kommer finnas tillgänliga.

ai.en: Evigt Edvin, a show by Edvin Törnblom at Stockholm Waterfront. Foyer doors at 19:30, hall doors at 20:15 and show at 21:00. Ages 13 and over.

events.description: Dörrar foajé: 19:30 Dörrar till salog: 20.15 Show start: 21.00 Åldersgräns 13 år

ai.en: Nobel Creations 2026 at the Nobel Prize Museum, interpretations of this year's Nobel Prizes by first-year fashion students.

events.description: See interpretations of this year’s Nobel Prizes, created by first-year students in the fashion programme at Beckmans College of Design. In the exhibition, art, science, literature and peace meet in an exploratory dialogue. The creations explore what unites Nobel Prize laureates, artists and designers: creativity – the courage to think in new ways, to challenge established theories and to combine insights from different fields in innovative ways.
A Lucia concert at Sofia Church in Södermalm. Traditional Swedish Christmas music with uplifting and atmospheric songs marking the start of the Christmas celebrations.

Discover Moveat’s unique take on the traditional Swedish *julbord* (Christmas smörgåsbord) through a culinary walking tour. The Moveat Christmas experience blends tradition with innovation. You will visit carefully selected restaurants, delis, and bakeries to enjoy Christmas-inspired tasting portions. Guided by the Moveat app, you can explore classic holiday flavors – with a modern twist – at your own pace and in the order you choose.

Sparkling like a sparkler, a Christmas brew of polska, tango, waltz, folk song, and traditional Christmas music is served up! Livets Orkester weaves together their own Christmas tale featuring powerful polskas, striking tangos, swirling waltzes, Balkan grooves, and folk songs. Original music by the band is blended with traditional Christmas tunes in their own unique twist. Expect music that lulls, comforts, uplifts, and sweeps you off your feet!

ai.en: Christmas in the 1800s at Torekällberget, with a Christmas market, performances and a historic setting.

events.description: History comes to life at Torekällberget with a Christmas market, Christmas bustle, and performances. Step directly into the atmosphere of the 1800s with living environments, historical characters, and Christmas music. Experience variety shows, traditional games, a Lucia procession, and a meeting with Santa in his hideaway. The scent of mulled wine, gingerbread, and roasted almonds fills the air.

Over 200 artists, crafters, authors, needleworkers and other creators exhibit at Nördarnas Julmarknad, alongside geek-friendly stores. Here visitors can explore Fantasy, Sci-fi, Board games, TV-games, Comics, Books, Art, Cosplay, Larp, Roleplaying games and much more! The market offers arts and crafts for children and adults, face painting, and a lucia-train of Cosplayers spreading Christmas joy. Visitors can also try light saber fighting, airsoft and various games. procession

Welcome to SEMF Christmas Edition, EARLY MUSIC SWEDEN’s cosy winter festival in Stockholm’s beautiful German Church! Midvinterfolk (Emilia Amper & Friends) brings Christmas to life with enchanting Swedish folk music. Cracow Singers & Players offer sparkling Polish Christmas treasures, while organists Dierks & Sjöström close the festival with a magical late-night concert on mattresses, featuring two organs in stereo. Step into the warmth – it’s never too cold for early music!

On the first weekend of December, 5–6 December, it’s time once again for Vaxholm traditional Christmas market. With roasted almonds, crafts, mulled wine and Christmas trees, we’ll get the christmas spirit going together. Santa Claus is coming – are you?

ai.en: Nobel Week Lights, a free festival of light in Stockholm during the darkest time of the year.

events.description: Nobel Week Lights is a festival lighting up Stockholm during the darkest time of the year – a free cultural experience for all. This year, the festival takes place in both Tensta and in the city centre. The light art festival invites international and local artists, designers, and students to create public light artworks inspired by the Nobel Prize.

A Zero8 Christmas, the annual Christmas concert, returns this year to the stunning Högalid Church on Saturday, December 5th. Two performances are scheduled – giving guests the chance to choose between different times. The concert features beloved Swedish Christmas classics, traditional choral music, and fresh arrangements with barbershop influences, all presented in Zero8's signature sound.
The Farmer's Own Christmas Market is a popular event. The products on sale are locally sourced, and there are a lot of organic products to choose from!

title.en: Christmas Market by Beckman College of Design

events.description: Find unique Christmas gifts designed by students of design, fashion and visual communication at the Beckman College of Design. On the weekend of December 6-7, they will take over the large greenhouse for their annual Christmas market! Lunch and coffee will be served in the café. With a bonfire in the courtyard, expect the spirit of Christmas to light up greenhouses and farm shops.

title.en: Stockholm Christmas Walk - the tastes of Christmas

ai.en: The Stockholm Christmas Walk, an evening of Christmas flavours, lights and city sights in central Stockholm.

events.description: Experience Stockholm at its most magical during an evening filled with Christmas flavours, beautiful lights and festive surprises. The Stockholm Christmas Walk takes you along a carefully selected route through decorated streets, with food stops, warm drinks, sweet treats, a Polaroid keepsake and an intimate Christmas concert by Stockholm Academic Women’s Choir. A Christmas experience to share with someone special.

title.en: Christmas Market at the Nordic Museum 2026

events.description: Welcome to the Christmas Market in Stora hallen with unique and sustainable Christmas gifts on Saturday, December 5th! A number of invited profiles in antiques, crafts, and second-hand are on site in collaboration with Gustav Broström (@gustavsrum).

ai.en: A winter kayak tour during Nobel Week, past the light art of Stockholm in December.

events.description: Every December, Stockholm comes alive with light art during Nobel Week. A magical winter kayak tour offers the chance to admire the City Hall’s spectacular light installation from the water. The experience includes a cozy Swedish fika, featuring a hot drink and cinnamon bun. All equipment is provided – just dress warm and enjoy!

ai.en: Schysst Jul, a fair and ethical Christmas market at ABF huset.

events.description: A fair and ethical Christmas market, "Schysst Jul", is Stockholm’s market with a conscience! Visitors can explore a unique selection of products from exhibitors who prioritize ecological sustainability, social justice, and fair trade. From handicrafts and art to food, toys, and home decor – everything is carefully chosen to contribute to a better world.

title.en: The Musical - Christmas in My Heart

ai.en: The Musical: Christmas in My Heart at the Salvation Army hall on Hornsgatan, a Christmas musical with songs and singing.

events.description: A musical performance centered around the theme of Christmas. The experience offers a mix of music, singing, and scenic storytelling that celebrates the spirit and traditions of the holiday season.

ai.en: Goodnight, Texas at Debaser Nova, a folk rock band built around storytelling.

events.description: Goodnight, Texas is a hard-to-define folk rock band with storytelling at its core, whose strength lies in unexpected points of connection. Goodnight, Texas has toured with artists such as The Dead South, Larkin Poe, Shakey Graves, and John Craigie. In 2020, their song The Railroad was also used as the opening theme for the first episode of Tiger King. Maybe that’s where you first heard them.

Färgfabriken Christmas Marknad is one of Stockholm's largest markets for arts and crafts and design. We offer our visitors an exciting selection among the market tables; shop directly from the designers and come home with something unique!

ai.en: Dundertåget at Debaser Strand, following their return at Sweden Rock.

events.description: Following their acclaimed return at Sweden Rock, Dundertåget are coming to Stockholm for a highly anticipated show at Debaser, honouring the memory of Robert “Strängen” Dahlqvist. Dundertåget was formed in 2004 by Robert “Strängen” Dahlqvist, alongside his role as guitarist in The Hellacopters. Over several years, the band became one of the most celebrated names in Swedish rock before calling it quits in 2012. Five years later, Robert Dahlqvist tragically passed away at the age of just 40.

title.en: Christmas Concert with Lisa Nilsson and Nordic vocalists

events.description: As winter darkness deepens, acclaimed Swedish singer Lisa Nilsson joins Nordic vocalists for a Christmas concert filled with warmth, beautiful harmonies and heartfelt music. Accompanied by an ensemble of accomplished musicians, they bring festive music to life through carefully crafted arrangements. Experience the magic of Christmas in the beautiful setting of Ersta Church, with music to lift the spirits and offer a moment of peace.

In the idyllic castlegrounds of Tyresö Castle you will find Tyresö Handelsträdgård. You are invited to join the festivities when they fill upp the greenhouses with plants and decorations for christmas. The market is held inside one of the greenhouses and therefore you can walk protected against the cold winterwinds. They have different stallholders who will sell arts, crafts and delicacies, more info on social media @tyresohandelstradgard

Eken Christmas Market is one of Stockholm’s largest Christmas markets for vintage, second-hand and handmade goods. This year it runs over two weekends at Förbindelsehallen in Slakthusområdet. Each weekend brings together hundreds of carefully selected sellers offering everything from vintage clothing and design pieces to handmade objects.

ai.en: Andreas Hallén's Ett juloratorium, a Christmas oratorio at Engelbrektskyrkan in Stockholm, performed by Engelbrekt Vocalis with soloists and musicians from the Radio Symphony Orchestra.

events.description: Engelbrekt Vocalis Jessica Elevant sopran Joel Annmo tenor Musiker ur Radiosymfonikerna Joakim Elevant dirigent Hallén är >>operatonsättaren som skrev ett juloratorium<<. Musiken är utåtriktat romantisk sam- tidigt som den är intim. Svenskt vemod sammanflätas med julmelodier från förr. Hallén var djupt rotad i svensk konstmusik samtidigt som en av hans stora förebilder var Wagner. I Ett juloratorium får du följa julens berättelse med profetian om hopp från urminnes tider till det att barnet, som skulle förändra allt, föds i Betlehem. Var hälsad sköna morgonstund! Insläppstid: 16:30 Längd: 1 tim

title.en: Christmas Market & Open Studios in Röda Bergen

events.description: Join us for a festive day of contemporary art, handmade crafts, and holiday cheer in the heart of Vasastan. On Sunday, December 6 between11:00–16:00 four creative studios in the historic neighborhood of Röda Bergen in Stockholm will open their doors to the public. Come meet the artists behind the works, get a behind-the-scenes look into their creative spaces, and discover unique, sustainable Christmas gifts made with care. Rödabergsbrinken 4 & Vanadisplan 6. Metro S:t Eriksplan and Odenplan.

title.en: A Star Shines Bright! feat. Granado & Stengård

events.description: Beloved Christmas Melodies, Opera, Sing-Alongs and Magical Favourites Welcome to a warm and joyful concert in the winter darkness, where the light of music brightens the Advent and Christmas season. Clarice Granado and Johan Stengård invite you on a varied musical journey. The programme ranges from magnificent works such as Nessun dorma to well-known songs including Happy New Year and The Prayer, alongside Swedish Christmas favourites, sing-alongs, and magical music from the world of Disney.
A traditional Lucia concert at Huddinge Church. The concert offers a festive experience with classic Christmas music and Lucia songs, typical of the Swedish Christmas tradition.

ai.en: Stockholm Santa Run, a charity race in Kungsträdgården run by the association Together We Make a Change for 12 years.

events.description: For 12 years, the association Together we make a change has organized the charity race Stockholm Santa Run. The race, which is organized entirely on a non-profit basis, involves all participants dressing up in Santa costumes and running/walking/jogging a 3-6 km distance in Stockholm's inner city. Most welcome to a day full of christmas spirit and joy!

title.en: Allt + Special guests: AVRALIZE + Bite Down

ai.en: Allt with AVRALIZE and Bite Down at Debaser Strand, a Swedish metalcore headline show.

events.description: Swedish metalcore act Allt comes to Debaser for a headline show. Formed in 2020, the band blends heavy metalcore with progressive, atmospheric and cinematic elements and a strong conceptual narrative. Following the acclaimed debut album “From The New World” and touring across Europe and the US, expect an intense live experience where power, emotion and visuals collide.

ai.en: Meet Lucia at the Cathedral 2026 at Storkyrkan, with Stockholm's children's and youth choirs in the Lucia celebration.

events.description: In the glow of the Lucia crown and the candles, some of Stockholm's best children's and youth choirs, including Storkyrkans Kammarkör and St. Jacob's Vocal Ensemble, sing the beloved songs that belong to the special Swedish tradition of Lucia and Staffan celebrations. The Lucia procession makes its entrance and the light illuminates the deepest darkness.

Gamla Filmstaden offers a Christmas market in classic film style, held where film greats such as Greta Garbo and Ingmar Bergman started their careers. As well as market stalls selling food, arts and crafts, there will be guided tours, film screenings and live performances.

title.en: Ben Folds – Paper Airplane Request Tour

ai.en: Ben Folds' Paper Airplane Request tour at Göta Lejon, in two acts.

events.description: The Paper Airplane Request Tour concert will consist of two acts. The first half will feature a carefully curated set list. The second half will feature songs requested by the audience via paper airplanes that they send up onto the stage.

title.en: Finland's Independence Day Concert: Ida Elina

events.description: Join us in celebrating Finland’s Independence Day with a unique concert featuring the internationally acclaimed singer-songwriter and kantele virtuoso Ida Elina. Through her slap style technique, she has redefined the image of kantele music and transformed Finland’s national instrument into an expressive vehicle for both pop and folk music. Her concerts combine outstanding musicianship with a captivating stage presence and a gift for storytelling.

title.en: Lucia at the Berwald Concert Auditorium 2026

events.description: Light up December with a Christmas concert in Berwaldhallen, home to the Swedish Radio Philharmonics. Featuring both American Christmas carols and traditional Swedish Lucia songs, the concert is performed by children from the Nacka Music School in Stockholm.

Art Exhibition, Sempre Mia – Per JosephsonThe exhibition presents eight oil paintings inspired by the life of Queen Christina of Sweden and her nearly thirty years in Rome, with a particular focus on her relationship with Cardinal Decio Azzolino

ai.en: Fröken Elvis's Christmas show, touring Sweden in December, at Intiman.

events.description: This December, the popular band is once again touring across Sweden with their beloved Christmas performance — an evening filled with humor, warmth, a touch of seriousness, and a whole lot of instruments! Expect personal interpretations of both traditional Christmas songs and modern holiday classics, Elvis’s greatest hits in Swedish, and music from the band’s ten-year career.

ai.en: An author talk with the Norwegian playwright Arne Lygre at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern on 8 December.

events.description: One of Norway’s most acclaimed playwrights will be a guest at International Writers' Stage December 8. In an in-depth conversation, Arne Lygre will meet with psychologist and author Anna Kåver to explore the existential themes that characterize his award-winning plays. A conversation centered on the search for meaning, loneliness, and the tentative yet demanding nature of friendship, moderated by Pontus Kipowski.

ai.en: Nacka Big Band's Christmas Extravaganza at Teater Bristol, combining big band jazz, vocals and humour.

events.description: Nacka Big Band presents a Christmas show combining big band jazz, vocals and humour. Saxophones, trumpets, trombones and a rhythm section are joined by vocalists Anki Modin-Strömgren and Leif Olsen. The repertoire ranges from Glenn Miller, Count Basie, Frank Sinatra and Ella Fitzgerald to Michael Bublé and Tom Jones, alongside well-known Christmas songs.

ai.en: A traditional Lucia celebration at Skansen with several concerts.

events.description: Come and experience a traditional and atmospheric Lucia celebration at Skansen. Several concerts will be held over the weekend, with some processions walking outdoors, and other being celebrated in the outdoor museum's historical buildings. No reservation possible – arrive early to secure your spot.

ai.en: Niklas Strömstedt's Tyck OM mig at China Teatern, based on his 2023 self-biographical book.

events.description: In 2023, the book *OM Niklas Strömstedt* was released – a self-biographical journey through both the small, personal life and the more public career. While working on the book, the idea was born to also let it serve as the foundation for a stage performance.

title.en: Emmi Christensson & Rickard Söderberg – A Peaceful Christmas

ai.en: A Peaceful Christmas, a Christmas concert with Emmi Christensson and Rickard Söderberg at Intiman.

events.description: A new Christmas concert filled with warmth, closeness and music that touches! After last year's success with a series of sold-out performances, the acclaimed musical star Emmi Christensson and the beloved and charismatic tenor Rickard Söderberg are once again taking to the winter roads. There will be favorites from last year, but also a lot of new ones. They will be joined by pianist Johan Reis and this year also by cellist Anna Wallgren.

title.en: Lucia on Water: A Spectacular Christmas Swim Show

ai.en: Lucia on Water, a Christmas swimming Lucia show at Forsgrenska badet by Simklubben Neptun.

events.description: Simklubben Neptun's Swimming Lucia Show is one of Stockholm's most unique and magical winter traditions. Held annually in the middle of December at Forsgrénska badet near Medborgarplatsen, this spectacular event features an unforgettable underwater and floating Lucia procession complete with floating torches, followed by breathtaking synchronized swimming routines performed by the club's competitive athletes.

Come and enjoy mulled wine and gingerbread cookies, candlelight, and beautiful Christmas music. Featuring Kraja, Karin Rehnqvist, English carols, and Jiminy Cricket! Olaus Petri Kyrka, Armfeltsgatan 2, Stockholm. Admission via Swish or in cash at the door. No advance booking required.

title.en: St. Lucia Procession 1 – Oktaverna and Tisdagskören

events.description: Celebrate Lucia at Gröndals kyrka with Tisdagskören and Oktaverna. The Lucia procession will be performed twice, at 5:30 PM and 6:30 PM.Participants:Tisdagskören and OktavernaBacking groupBoel Dirke, conductor

ai.en: AW Create at Presentmakeriet, a relaxed evening of crafting with bubbly and snacks.

events.description: A relaxing moment with bubbly, snacks, and stress-free crafting. Bring your colleagues, friends – or come by yourself and hang out in a warm, creative environment on Södermalm in Stockholm. We set out all the materials and inspiring seasonal ideas. Follow clear step-by-step instructions or create completely freely – the choice is yours. This is all about the joy of creating, good company, and easing gently into the weekend. For groups of 4 people or more, you can book other time slots.

ai.en: Stjärnjul 2026 at Filadelfia Convention Center in Stockholm, a Christmas show with guest artists, an orchestra and choirs.

events.description: STJÄRNJUL 2026 -- EN STJÄRNKASKAD AV JULMAGI OCH SHOW Stjärnjul är en explosion av stjärnglans, glädje och värme -- där storslagen show möter innerlig julkänsla. Upplev gästartister, orkester och körer i världsklass i en konsert som fyller både scen och salong med julens magi. I år gästas Stjärnjul av den hyllade West End-stjärnan Kerry Ellis. På scen står också Karl Dyall, Joachim Bergström och Rennie Mirro -- tre av Sveriges främsta entertainers, som även är kända som trion The High Society. Tillsammans med Stjärnjulkören, med omkring 180 sångare från Rönninge Show Chorus och The EntertainMen, samt Stjärnjulorkestern under ledning av Johan Landqvist bjuder Stjärnjul på en härlig mix av musik -- från klassiska julsånger till gospel, pop och storslagen show. Julstämning som räcker över hela julen!

title.en: Peggy Gou checks in at Hotel Grand Stade

events.description: Hotel Grand Stade proudly welcomes Peggy Gou for an unforgettable night at Banankompaniet. An internationally acclaimed DJ, producer and cultural icon, Peggy Gou brings her unmistakable blend of house, techno and infectious energy to the dance floor. On 11 December, step into the world of Hotel Grand Stade, where music, fashion and unexpected encounters come together under one roof. A place where the guests steal the show and the dance floor is always the main attraction.

Big band jazz, dancing, and St. Lucia atmosphere with Smilbandet. Smilbandet has played for dancing and parties for 25 years, blending classic 1950s and 60s big band arrangements à la Count Basie, Sammy Nestico, Quincy Jones, and Antônio Carlos Jobim with custom-written arrangements. We invite you to a dance night at Stallet to ring in the St. Lucia weekend! Come to dance and listen to plenty of groove, songs, and solists. With a little christmas cheer as well.

ai.en: Christmas with Jens, a concert at Ö2 Scenkonst where Jens Hult finds Christmas in music rather than in gifts or traditions.

events.description: For Jens Hult, Christmas isn’t primarily about gifts, stress, or perfect traditions. In his music, Christmas emerges as a time for memories, closeness, and reflection. Through songs like "Det blir en annan jul i år" and "Det är jul igen," he portrays both the joy of gathering and the longing many feel when someone significant is no longer at the Christmas table.

Lucia Morning is a traditional Swedish Christmas experience featuring choir singing and music. At Kungsholms Church, visitors can enjoy the Lucia choir and classic Lucia songs in a historic church setting.

title.en: Nothing left to do but cry  – theater in Italian, with subtitles

events.description: What would you do if you suddenly found yourself 500 years back in time? That’s exactly what happens to Mario and Saverio, who find themselves in the Renaissance and try to make the most of the situation – from inventing things and making music to trying to stop Columbus… A hilarious stage comedy inspired by the iconic film by Troisi and Benigni, packed with gags and live music. With Swedish and English subtitles.

title.en: Stjärnjul – A Cascade of Christmas Magic and Show

ai.en: Stjärnjul, a Christmas show at the Filadelfia Convention Center, a Stockholm Christmas show since 1993.

events.description: Stjärnjul is an explosion of starlight, joy and Christmas magic. Since 1993, this beloved Stockholm Christmas tradition has brought together acclaimed guest artists, the Stjärnjul Choir with around 180 singers from Rönninge Show Chorus and The EntertainMen, as well as a full orchestra. This year, West End star Kerry Ellis joins Karl Dyall, Joachim Bergström and Rennie Mirro – the trio The High Society. Christmas classics, gospel, pop and show – the perfect way to begin the festive season.

ai.en: A Lucia breakfast at Nalen with a traditional Lucia performance.

events.description: With a cozy breakfast and a traditional Lucia performance in one of Sweden’s most culturally historic and elegant venues. Enjoy overnight oats with berries, homemade bread with roasted tomatoes, cheese and cress, fruit salad, and a saffron bun with coffee or tea, as the songs and spirit of this cherished Swedish tradition fill Nalen.

title.en: Folkmusic- and dance for everyone at Kulturhuset!

ai.en: A folk music and dance evening for everyone at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern with the Folkmusikhuset community.

events.description: In collaboration with Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, the community Folkmusikhuset invites you to a festive evening full of music and dancing to live folkmusic. Have you ever tried social folk dancing? Then this is the perfect opportunity for you to discover and experience the folk groove! View the program and more info at Kulturhuset’s and Folkmusichouse's websites and on social media.

ai.en: A family Lucia concert at Engelbrektskyrkan in Stockholm, with the parish's children's and youth choirs and classic Christmas and Lucia songs.

events.description: Engelbrekts barnkör Engelbrekts diskantkör Engelbrekts Unga röster Vox Engelbrekt Madeleine Johansson flöjt Andreas Nyström slagverk Joakim Elevant orgel och piano Rebecka Käll dirigent Välkommen till en varm och familjevänlig luciakonsert där Engelbrekts församlings alla barn- och ungdomskörer medverkar. Här får stora och små uppleva luciatraditionens sånger och stämningar i ett program som passar hela familjen. En festlig stund fylld av musik, gemenskap och förväntan inför julen. Insläpp: 15:15 Köp biljetter i tid! Samma biljettpris gäller för både barn och vuxna.

title.en: John Lundvik med Mats Björkes Caravan – Julturné 2026

ai.en: John Lundvik and Mats Björkes Caravan's Christmas tour from 25 November at Rival in Stockholm, with classic and new Christmas songs and reinterpretations.

events.description: Den 25 november ger sig John Lundvik ut på en julturné tillsammans med Mats Björkes Caravan -- en turné fylld av värme och stämning. Tillsammans framför de klassiska och nya julsånger samt ett flöde av tolkningar och nya arrangemang. Publiken får följa med på en musikalisk resa som växlar mellan det mysiga och det storslagna och det blir en konsertupplevelse där julglädjen står i centrum. Turnén är inte bara en hyllning till julens musik, utan också ett levande bevis på vad som kan uppstå när två starka musikaliska personligheter möts och utvecklas tillsammans. Mats Björke, tidigare medlem i Mando Diao och en etablerad producent och kompositör, står för ett organiskt och finstämt sound som tillsammans med John Lundviks kraftfulla röst skapar ett unikt musikaliskt landskap. Samarbetet mellan Lundvik och Björke inleddes hösten 2025 i samband med albumet PSALM., där Lundvik tolkade några av våra mest älskade psalmer. Med tolkningar av klassiker som "Bered en väg för Herran", "Gläns över sjö och strand" och "Stilla natt" lades grunden för det fortsatta samarbetet. Julturnén 2026 tar detta vidare, från det eftertänksamma uttrycket i PSALM. till den levande energin på scen, där nya musikaliska landskap utforskas med publiken som självklar medresenär. Välkomna till en konsert där tradition möter förnyelse! Längd: ca 90 minuter, ingen paus Åldersgräns: 18 år, 13år i målsmans sällskap Arrangör: All Things Live Läs våra köpvillkor här!

ai.en: Free entry at the Postmuseum on Tuesday 15 December to celebrate its 120th anniversary.

events.description: Tisdagen den 15 december fyller Postmuseum 120 år! Vi firar hela dagen genom att bjuda alla besökare på fri entré. Följ med på en historisk visning genom huset Från några få rum i starten växte museet sakta men säkert till att ta plats i hela huset. Är du nyfiken på hur vårt gamla hus har förändrats under de 120 år som museet har funnits? Följ med på en visning där vi berättar om både post- och museihistoria, pågår cirka en timme.

ai.en: A Christmas Night show at Oscarsteatern with Jessica Andersson.

ai.en: Cory Wong's The Fretboard Odyssey at Fållan in Stockholm in December, with guest musicians including Mark Lettieri and Ariel Posen. Ages 18 and over.

events.description: WITH SPECIAL GUESTS: Mark Lettieri, Ariel Posen, Louis Cato, Henrik Linder, Kevin Gastonguay Åldersgräns 18 år Grammy-nominerade Cory Wong tar "The Fretboard Odyssey" till Stockholm i december Grammy-nominerade gitarristen, kompositören och producenten Cory Wong kommer till Stockholm för en efterlängtad spelning på Fållan den 17 december. Cory Wong har gjort sig känd världen över för sin smittande spelglädje, sylvassa funkgrooves och genreöverskridande samarbeten. Med en unik kombination av jazzens tekniska precision och energin från funk, pop och soul har han etablerat sig som en av samtidens mest dynamiska och uppskattade liveartister. Den Minneapolis-födde musikern fick sitt internationella genombrott genom funkkollektivet Vulfpeck, där hans rytmiska gitarrspel och karismatiska scenpersonlighet blev en central del av bandets karaktäristiska sound. Sedan dess har han byggt upp en framgångsrik solokarriär med en imponerande och mångsidig albumkatalog. Nu kommer han till Stockholm med turnén "The Fretboard Odyssey". Det blir en storslagen livesatsning med särskilt inbjudna gästartister Mark Lettieri (gitarr), Ariel Posen (gitarr), Henrik Linder (bas), Kevin Gastonguay (keyboard) och Louis Cato (trummor). Publiken kan vänta sig mer än en konsert, det blir en hyllning till musikalitet och gitarrdriven livemusik. Arrangör: All Things Live Läs våra köpvillkor här!
